Mirei messages Yuki; saying King Drasil, Homeros, and Kunlun want to talk to them. Yuki goes to the In-Between Theater and visits them, with them giving Yuki the power to time travel to any time and place they had been to before. They say they did this because Yuki had had some difficulties recently and that it would help them prepare for the battle agaisnt Chronomon.

Longing for Akihabara

Yuki time travels to the past, and receives a message from Vulcanusmon who says he had got a part from an excellent action figure but that he needed advice about it. He shows them the action figure hand, and asks them to go to Akihabara to find a figure from the same series as that one. He gives them the hand and a receipt that was with it, and when Yuki goes to the store they run into Monica Simmons. She's surprised to learn that Yuki is into action figures as well, and becomes even more surprised to see them with the hand of a figure from a limited edition Sayori Magical Girl figure. Yuki says why they were actually there, and Monica suggests a specific Sayori figure saying their client would love it. Yuki tries to buy it, though when the clerk says it's ¥600,000 they protest and say it's too much. Monica steps in and says she'll buy it for them if it's for a Digimon, and asks them to explain one day why they needed it. Yuki takes the figure to Vulcanusmon, who is delighted with it.

Final Battle Challenger

Merukimon messages Yuki, asking them to visit him as he has a problem. When they arrive, they see Pharaohmon and Rapidmon (Armor) begging to be in the front lines for the next battle as they had been unable to help retake Central Town — with Merukimon apprehensive. He asks Yuki to talk to them, and they say they became strong by living in harsh conditions and rescuing Digimon from the Titans, but wanted to become stronger as they had struggled in their battles against said Titans. Though he was moved by their words, he was worried about letting them join as he didn't know their strength as well as the upcoming battle being more dangerous than any other. Yuki suggests testing their strength in the colosseum, and Merukimon agrees and tasks Yuki to do it as he is too busy to do it himself. After the battle, regardless of Yuki's answer, they say they're joining the fight — with this annoying Merukimon. He no longer minded though, as he had seen they were strong enough to put up a decent fight against Yuki.

Memories of Bonds

A cosplayer messages Yuki saying there's two amazing cosplayers in Akihabara and that they should go see them. Once Yuki meets up with the cosplayer, they point them in the direct of the two amazing ones and Yuki goes to find them. Yuki finds them and learns they're not cosplayers, it's just Asuna Shiroki and BeelStarmon. Yuki eavesdrops on their conversation, where the duo reminisce about how BlackGatomon digivolved to BeelStarmon in response to Asuna becoming her friend. They also talk about how much they've improved each other. They notice Yuki had been eavesdropping, and say how Yuki was actually part of that moment too — and so thank them as they helped them to become friends.

A Stubborn Fog

Yuki time travels to the past, and receives a message from a Punimon who says the fog was so bad it got scared and returned to Gear Forest. It asks for help to get through it, and asks them to talk to Cherrymon. Yuki asks Cherrymon to remove the fog, but it refuses. Yuki attacks and defeats Cherrymon, though it still refuses. Sirenmon shows up and asks what's going on, with Cherrymon saying it was doing as it was told as Sirenmon had told it not to let anyone through. Sirenmon says she had already told it that Yuki and the others are her guests, and as such should be allowed through. Cherrymon remembers this, and says he hadn't recognised them because of the fog. A tremor happens, with Sirenmon saying it was as she feared and that Cherrymon had put the fog up as she was worried about intruders. They travel further in, and find a MegaKabuterimon on a rampage due to the Current's powers. It comes to its senses after they beat it up, and Sirenmon performs a ritual to safeguard the area.

Encounters beyond Space-Time

Mirei Mikagura tells Yuki that a powerful Digimon from another World had started to encroach this one and asks them to defeat it. She sets up an Outer Dungeon they can use to travel there.

Dreams or Reality?

Yuki collects Hiroko Sagisaka's monikers. Some are in the present, and some are in the past.

All Eyes on Me!

Etemon asks Yuki to time travel to eight years ago and collect his Soul Bits. Yuki does so.

Silent Envy

Monica Simmons tells Yuki that Toya Kuga released a bunch of Kuramon in Tokyo, and asks them to defeat them all. Yuki does so. Each of them has a Core Dump, which have Kuga's thoughts inside.

What Is Love?

Minervamon messages Yuki, wondering about if love can change a person — and asks Yuki to come talk to her in Central Town. They go to Minervamon's house, where she brings up Junomon going crazy due to love. She doesn't understand the concept, and wonders if people change when they have feelings for someone. She says she doesn't want to change by falling in love, and so needs to learn what it is before it could change her. As humans know the most about love, she says they should talk to an expert — and suggests Hiroko Sagisaka. Hiroko says it's hard to explain, and that even psychologists and philosophers don't have the answer. She says how each person has their own form of love, and that that means she'd have to study lots of love not just one. She suggests watching romance movies, and they watch one about a motorcycle thief. Though she didn't really get the movie, she thought the guy riding a motorcycle was cool and that's what she'd like it to be like if she ever fell in love as shed didn't think it would change her. Whilst she still didn't understand love, she did gain a new appreciation for movies and thanks Yuki for helping.

Premonitions of Love

Minervamon still doesn't understand love, and asks Yuki to come talk to her in Rebellion Village. She says she finds human love insignificant, and that there's no reason to let it dictate your actions. Though she found human love boring, she excitedly says they need to look into love between Digimon and asks Yuki to let her know if they find a worthy Digimon. She asks them to find a Digimon as cool as the motorcycle hero from the movie she saw, and asks them to talk to the nearby Tanemon as it must know loads about Digimon since it was playing the Jogmon card game. Tanemon show off its Beelzemon card, and says it's the only Digimon known to ride a motorcycle (Behemoth). Yuki brings their own Beelzemon to Minervamon, who is speechless when seeing it riding its own Behemoth. She leaves to clear her head, and says how she felt strange and crazy. When Yuki goes back to her, she says she felt something warm in her chest — as well as tightness and pain — and says she's going to stay in the village to figure out what it is.

Triumph is Mine

Minervamon says she needs to do something about the feeling, and asks Yuki to come talk to her in Rebellion Village. When Yuki does, Minervamon demands they fight her. She says she's felt weird ever since seeing Yuki's Beelzemon, and, unable to to put it into words, decided she needed to fight Yuki. She figures beating Yuki would put her mind at ease, as Yuki hangs out with tough Digimon — though ends up being defeated. She complains about the loss, and says she needs to get stronger before the battle against Chronomon. She says her feelings held her back, and so she needs to shut herself away until she becomes stronger. Something surges within her, and she thinks she's about to digivolve... but then nothing happens. It helped clear her mind though, so she thanks Yuki and gives them a reward.

Minervamon's Decision

Minervamon messages Yuki, saying she needs to tell them about something that's bothering her and to meet her at her house in Central Town. She says she heard the Beelzemon of the Seven Great Demon Lords was near the Factorial Area, and asks Yuki to go with them to see. They find him, and he says he would usually kill them — but can't as his guns and Behemoth are out of commission. Yuki suggests attacking Beelzemon whilst he was weakened, but Minervamon refuses as she wouldn't be satisfised with a win like that. They offer to help fix them, so that they can fight him in a fair battle. He agrees, and they get the materials for him. He fixes them, then fights them in the coliseum as Beelzemon BM. Minervamon and Yuki win, and Beelzemon leaves as promised. Minervamon says she feels a weight has been lifted as she no longer finds herself admiring another and says she needs to better herself. She then thanks Yuki for their help and gives them a reward.

The Helper from Shambala

Kunlun messages Yuki and asks them to come visit him. When Yuki does, he explains that he's the Host Computer of Digital World: Shambala and that the Digimon he brought with him — Susanoomon and a few others — hadn't been in contact lately and that they seem to be having too much fun in Digital World: Iliad. He says they went to the Paradise Colosseum to train, and asks Yuki to go there and remind them of their mission.

The Forgetful Helpers

Yuki goes to the Paradise Colosseum and finds three of Kunlun's helpers, Kotemon, Musyamon, and Zanbamon. Yuki mentions they were sent by Kunlun, and they remember they hadn't been in contact for a while. They say they had come to train and had just lost track of time, an figure Yuki must be a strong warrior from Digital World: Iliad to have been sent by Kunlun. As they find the Colosseum too fun, they refuse orders and say they'll only listen if Yuki can defeat them in battle. Yuki defeats them, though they say it isn't over as they still need to defeat Susanomon.

Susanomon the Hero

Yuki defeats Susanomon, and so, as agreed, it, Kotemon, Musyamon, and Zanbamon contact Kunlun and leave to join the Royal Knights at Central Tower.

Scariest Face in the World

Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki, saying she got a tip about a missing person's case and asks them to come and help her with it. She says a girl named Kurumi messaged her, with them reading her email to see that her Instructor Saburo Miura had gone missing. She says there's a ghost story at her school that claims there's a red book in the library that you can't stop reading once you start it. Once you finish it you feel a tap on the back, then see the scariest face in the world when you turn around. This caused all the students to become scared of reading, which upset Mr Miura. To try and prove the story wrong he read the book, which was about his own life. This scared him, and he continued to read — even refusing to return to class so he could finish the book. She says there were sightings of him at Shinjuku Park, with the witness reports saying he was still reading the book. Yuki suggests going to the park, but Hiroko turns them down saying she wants to look into something first. Hiroko goes on her own, and finds the book on the bench. She starts reading it, with the book being about her own life as well. Hours later, when Hiroko finishes the book, a man appears behind her. The Operator contacts Yuki and says they had been tracking Hiroko, and that she had just gone into the sewers after spending hours at Shinjuku Park. Yuki goes to where Hiroko's signal vanishes, and finds and Outer Dungeon. Once inside, Yuki finds a Wendigomon with lots of humans. It admits to having made the book, says how much fun it was to scare humans — and that it is able to harvest lots of energy from them. It attacks Yuki, though is defeated. Yuki saves them, and Hiroko admits she was captured on purpose as that was the quickest way to be able to solve it. They return all the humans to the human world, where they lie to Miura and say they and Kurumi found him passed out. He thanks them for their help, and he goes home to rest. Kurumi then thanks them for their help.

Fulfilling a Great Ambition

Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki, saying there's someone she wants them to meet. Once Yuki arrives at the detective agency, she introduces them to Norio — a supposed time traveller from the past. He says he originated from eight years ago, and was caught up in an explosion (the same one that sent Yuki eight years into the future as well). Since the same thing happened to Yuki, Hiroko figured they were the best person for the job. Yuki takes him to Mirei Mikagura, who confirms he had indeed travelled in time — and attempts to send him back to the past. Instead of return to the past, he and Yuiki end up in an Outer Dungeon. Millenniummon refuses to let him return to his own time, and attacks him — though Yuki is able to defeat it and protect him. Defeated, Millenniummon says it will let him alone — but still plans to enjoy itself. Yuki takes Norio to the past, then returns to the present. Norio from the present shows up, and says he thinks the young version of himself will show up again and that he had actually visited his future self before going to Hiroko. This had caused issues, as the original present version of Norio was a rich successful business man that was married to Hanae — the girl he had a crush on — and that the current version was a broke single man as he had assumed his life would be successful so partied instead of working hard. He asks them to help him fake their meeting, as past Nori seeing current would cause the timeline to shift even further and cause current Norio to cease to exist. They rent a suit and convince Hanae to pretend she's married to him, which she agrees to as she thinks it'd be fun to pretend she's a private investigator. Past Norio is impressed, though Hanae bursts the bubble and says she can't do it any more — admitting the truth. Present Norio explains what happened, and a distraught past asks to return to the his own time period. Before Yuki can do so, Hiroko brings up that the entire situation was weird — Yuki and Inori Misono disappeared for eight years, whist Norio didn't. Millenniummon, who had seemingly been watching everything, says Hiroko was smart to notice — and summons everyone back to the Outer Dunegon. It says it had taken an interest in Norio, and that what she mentioned had happened as it messed with space-time to allow it. Not wanting its fun to be over, it attacks them again — but is defeated again. It begs to be killed, though both Norio say it's fine and they didn't mind what had happened and even saw it as a pleasant experience. Millenniummon apologizes, and tells the past Norio to live a good life. Yuki has Mirei send him to the past again, where he says he will make sure not to become a loser in the future. When Yuki returns to the present, the timeline changes again — this time, they actually are married and Norio was a successful businessman.

Observing the Underworld

Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki, saying she found a picture of herself from high school and that they should come reminisce with her over it. It's a picture of her class, and she recognises and realises that Kinshiro Eriito — a guy who once asked her to help find his parents — was in her class back then. She wasn't able to help him, and says she wishes they could go back in time as she thinks Yuki would be able to help find them. Yuki travels back in time eight years, and goes to Shinjuku Park — where Hiroko had said she'd met up with him back then. Yuki finds Kinshiro, and the teenage Hiroko is surprised to see Yuki was already there. They both explain that he's a genius, and they explain that he had never met his parents — he was a designer baby made through donated DNA. Kinshiro mocks regular humans, and compares them to primates — saying he only goes to high school because he wanted to study dumb people and see how they live in such squalor. Hiroko mentions Monica Simmons is likely familiar with the lab, and they track her down with the help of Asuna Shiroki. They find her being attacked by a group of Piximon, leading Yuki to save her. They explain Kinshiro story to her, and she says the data is probably top secret and thus they'll have to hack to get access to it. Kinshiro says he already tried and that his computer wasn't powerful enough, and she says it's fine as they can use hers and she wanted to look into them anyway as she's heard they're doing illegal genetic modifications. She performs the hack, and and tells him that his parents were chimpanzees. This upsets him, since it means he can't talk to them. That's not all though, Kinshiro will eventually turn into a chimpanzee. After he ran away, Hiroko asks how long he has — and she says in eight years he'll be a full primate. Yuki returns to the present, and finds a human Kinshiro in Seibu-Shinjuku. Kinshiro recognises Yuki, and says he and some others found a way to have him remain human. Doing so helped him learn to appreciate others, and he ended enjoying meeting his parents. As thanks for helping out eight years ago, he gives them a reward.

Royal Knights, Assemble!

King Drasil messages Yuki, saying she needs their help. Yuki travels to the VIP room of the In-Between Theater, in which King Drasil is with Agumon and Gabumon. They mention to King Drasil how they were already familiar with Yuki, and how strong they are — saying they can help them for sure. She says she was in Digital World: Iliad as it was in trouble, and that she had brought the Royal Knights with her. As they were unfamiliar with this world, they all got lost — and as such, she asks Yuki to go find them all and get them to gather at Central Tower. She says it will be hard, as she had given them human forms — and Yuki goes to the rendezvous point with Agumon and Gabumon (who are one of the Royal Knights as Omnimon). They give Yuki some supplies, then send them off to find their allies.

Knowing One's Strength

Craniamon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki, saying he was at Central Tower but that he wasn't sure of himself as everyone in Digital World: Illiad was strong. Yuki finds him wounded, and he explains he had fought enemies on the way there. He asks if Yuki thinks he can be of use in his current state, and Yuki suggests to ask a fortune teller. They go to the one in Shinjuku, who was actually AncientWisemon (though Craniamon was unaware of this). He tells Craninamon (who was in his human disguise) to go to subroad, and that he will get his answer from a man there that is eating a crepe. They travel there, and the man says it must be Digimon related when he mentions he was sent by a fortune teller. They explain how Craniamon had lost his confidence, and the man says how he knows that the "human" was Craniamon. He says the best way to deal with it is to challenge the strongest Titan — Plutomon. They travel to the Dark Field together, where Craniamon challenges Plutomon. He turns it down, and says he cannot fight a Royal Knight as everyone would take it too seriously. He instead tells Craniamon to challenge Enbarrmon, the immortal steed, and says he'll personally take him to Enbarrmon as fate had brought them together. Crainamon thanks Yuki for their helpp, and says he's going to go fight Enbarrmon.

Showdown with the Immortal Steed

Yuki, Craniamon, and Plutomon challenge Enbarrmon — the goal being helping Crainamon to win so he can regain his confidence. They defeat it, and Enbarrmon says it enjoyed the battle. Plutomon says that means it considers Craniamon worthy, and Enbarrmon proves this by allowing Craniamon to ride it. This causes them to become Craniamon + Enbarrmon, with Craniamon happy as the addition of flight has him feeling more powerful. Yuki reminds him to go to the rendezvous point, and so he does so — taking his new steed with him. Plutomon was also happy, as it meant the rampaging Enbarrmon had been dealt with.

Secrets Are for Sharing

A Bakemon messages messages Yuki, saying something scary was happening in Plutomon's castle and that it was too scared to investigate itself. Yuki meets up with it, and it says it senses a powerful aura inside the castle. Once Yuki goes inside, they see Plutomon having a meeting with Imperialdramon FM. Imperialdramon says that it was actually the "human" who helped them with Craniamon, and that it was returning to the human world as it knew Dark Field was safe in Plutomon's hands. Plutomon had actually sent Imperialdramon as an undercover agent, his mission being to protect the human world...though Imperialdramon only really cared about the human world's sweets. Imperialdramon invites Yuki to a sweets festival, and Plutomon notices Yuki's disappointment over non-seriousness of their conversation. Yuki returns to Bakemo and says it had sensed Imperialdramon, and it says it's glad Plutomon is okay.

One Shield Maker's Struggle

Gallantmon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki, saying he had gone to Factorial Town to repair his equipment. Yuki goes to him and reminds him he needs to go to the rendezvous point, but he says he can't as his equipment got destroyed by a firewall. He came to this area to get Chrondigizoit to fix it, but noticed the area was crawling with evil Digimon. Not wanting to damage his equipment even further, he asks Yuki for help. They go into the mines, and find a rampaging Chaosdramon in the way. It refuses to leave, wanting all the Chrondigizoit for itself — and so the two of them beat it up. Chaosdramon runs away, allowing Gallantmon to use the Chrondigizoit to repair its equipment. Chaosdramon shows up and attacks them again, wanting revenge — but loses even quicker than last time thanks to Gallantmon being back at full strength. He thanks Yuki for their help and agrees to go to the rendezvous point after giving Yuki a reward.

Veemon's Growth

Veemon messages Yuki, saying he was in the sanctuary in Gear Forest with a human hating WereGarurumon. Yuki goes to them, and WereGarurumon says it knew a human would show up eventually and that humans were dangerous if they could sense the area's energy. Veemon says WereGarurumon is being too negative, but WereGarurumon says Veemon just doesn't understand and that he should talk to Yuki as they're a human to learn what humans are like. After WereGarurumon leaves, Veemon asks if humans are dangerous, though says he'll just go to the human world and decide himself if it was actually true. He says for Yuki to take him somewhere that'll help him understand humans, and so Yuki takes him to various restaurants. Veemon is happy with this, as the best way to learn people's culture is through your stomach — and eats some ice cream. Veemon loves it, and says he's happy to have learned about humans. They go back to the sanctuary, where Veemon digivolves to Magnamon and says he was actually one of the Royal Knights. He loved the ice cream so much he decides he wants to defend humanity, and says he's going to go to the mines to refine his armor. He then thanks Yuki for their help.

Bring Your Own Materials

Magnamon messages Yuki, saying he was in Factorial Town and needed help fixing his armor. Yuki visits him, and he says he travelled here as he needed Chrondigizoit Metal to repair his armor. There was an issue though... and Guardromon explain there was currently a shortage Chrondigizoit Ore — one of the materials used to make the Metal. LoaderLeomon's mine hadn't got enough lately, and so Guadromon says it'll take them to a different mine and that they can go mine in there and help out. Though he would usually do it by himself, Magnamon asks Yuki to help as he wants to guarantee success. They find some, and get attacked by an angry Breakdramon who accuses them of stealing it. It doesn't care that Mangamon got permission, and says it all belongs to it. Yuki fights it, and tells Magnamon to repair its armor whilst they do. Magnamon repairs his armor and joins the fight half way in, and helps them to defeat it. Magnamon then thanks them for their help.

The Call of the Unseen

Examon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki, saying he was at Central Tower but that no one could see him. Once Yuki goes there, they hear a buzzing sound and assume its a fly (it's a mini Examon). The "fly" continues to make sounds, though Yuki is only able to hear parts of what mini Examon is saying. Examon is eventually able to get through, and introduces himself. He says he was always told he was too big, so made himself smaller — but went overboard. Unable to fix it, he asks Yuki for help. Yuki mentions a growth medicine, and Examon demands Yuki take him to some. Yuki takes him to Venusmon, who actually has said medicine... though shes unable to see Examon. She scatters it all over in the hopes some would land on him, and some does — making him slightly bigger. Venusmon is now able to see him, and they leave her house so they can continue increasing his size. As he gets bigger, a HerculesKabuterimon and its minions show up and attack Examon. The trio defeat the Titans, and Examon returns to his regular size after the battle. Now back to his regular size, he thanks Yuki and goes to the rendezvous point.

The Worthy

UlforceVeedramon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki, saying he went to the Abyss Santuary to repair his armor but that he doesn't know how to get a meeting with Neptunemon. Yuki meets up with him, where he says he had wanted to talk to Neptunemon as he had Blue Digizoid armor — but that he knows its a rare material and so he'd seen suspicious by wanting it. Yuki offers to introduce them, and takes him to Neptunemon. UlforceVeedramon explains the predicament, and Neptunemon says he uses the Chrondigizoit vein shown to him by JumboGamemon to repair his armor. UlforceVeedramon asks if he can have some, though Neptunemon says he can't just give it to anyone. UlforceVeedramon takes this as a test to prove himself, which Neptunemon confirms. He challenges UlforceVeedramon to battle, though says they should go somewhere else to even things out as he has the advantage underwater. UlforceVeedramon doesn't mind, though Neptunemon insists on a fair battle and allows Yuki to join in as that'd even things out. They defeat Neptunemon, and he acknowledges the knight's strength and agrees to share the Ore with him. He sends JumboGamemon to Factorial Town to process it, and asks Yuki to return after they've finished helping UlforceVeedramon. They go to Factorial Town, where UlforceVeedramon gets the metal. He thanks Yuki for their help, then goes to the rendezvous point.

To My Dearest

Neptunemon messages Yuki, saying he still has some Blue Digizoid left over and wants to ask a favor from them. Once Yuki arrives, he says he made a ring with the left over Blue Digizoid from when they fixed UlforceVeedramon's shield, and says he heard humans give rings to the one they find the most dear. Yuki confirms this, and Neptunemon says he wants to give it to Venusmon as thanks for returning his scarf. Rather than give it himself though, he asks Yuki to take it to her. Yuki travels to Central Town and gives it to her, and she's surprised to receive such a precious gift. She thinks, then remembers about Neptunemon telling her about Christmas and assumes it must be a Christmas present. She gives Yuki some medicine, and says to take it to Neptunemon as her Christmas present to him. Yuki takes it to him, and he's confused to receive it. Despite her seemingly not understanding his expression of gratitude, he still found himself satisfied — then says he tends not to understand his own feelings as well and had made the ring without thinking.

Duels Must Be Fair

Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki, saying she got a sus tip about Phase Electron Lifeform sightings. When Yuki goes to her, she says she finds the tipster more suspicious than the tip itself and says it was about a strange cosplayer in Higashi-Shinjuku. They wonder if the tipster was Kosuke Misono, with Hiroko also wondering why a Digimon would disguise itself as a human. Finding it interesting, she asks Yuki to meet up at the Koma Theater Square where the cosplayer had been seen. Upon arrival, they see Dynasmon being mocked by humans. This angers him, with him thinking they had no chivalry. Hiroko says he had been challenging people to duels for a while, but that no one had taken him seriously. She suggests for Yuki to talk to him, though says to be careful as it'll probably end up in a duel challenge. This is proven true, as Dynasmon challenges Yuki within seconds. Yuki accepts, and defeats Dynasmon. After the battle, Dynasmon notices something was amiss — and a Megadramon spawns. Dynasmon says he wont be able to defeat it alone, and asks for Yuki's help. They defeat it, and after the battle — he praises Yuki's stregnth and says they are worthy of carrying out King Drasil's orders (showing he knew who Yuki was the whole time). Satisifed, he leaves to go to the rendezvous point. Hiroko praises their fightings skills as well, and wonerrs again about why Kosuke would send her the tip. She figures he was testing her, and that he would've had other ways to deal with it had she failed. She then gives Yuki a reward for helping.

A Facilitator's Woes

A Lalamon messages Yuki, saying it was relaxing in the Shaded Woods and saw a strong Digimon show up. Yuki shows up, and the Lalamon says they should leave as the strong Digimon was rampaging. Yuki asks if it was a Titan, though it says no and that the strong Digimon was beating up Titans too. Despite the warning, Yuki goes further into the forest and is attacked by Leopardmon LM — who says he was annoyed by everyone being selfish and that he cannot please everyone. Leopardmon snaps out of it after the battle, and thanks Yuki for stopping him. He Mode Changes into regular Leopardmon, and introduces himself as the leader of the Royal Knights. He clarifies he was upset at them, as he had tried to assemble them but they had all scattered everywhere. He had ended up alone and became one with nature, which caused him to lose track of time. Yuki relays King Drasil's message about the Knights going to Central Tower, but Leopardmon says he doesn't feel confident about his leadership skills at the moment so will go there after some time spent reflecting. He then gives Yuki a reward for helping him remember his true goals.

Find a Lead Vocalist!

Bacchusmon messages Yuki, saying a band would make the party more lively. Yuki visits him, where a Kabuterimon mentions having a choir but not lead vocalist. Bacchusmon says ShogunGekomon is perfect for that role, and sends Yuki out with the mission to convince him to sing. Leopardmon also decides to help search, as his prowess as a lead vocalist intrigues him. They both find him in the sanctuary, and find him fighting a GranKuwagamon. They defeat it, and and ask him to join the band. He agrees, and they all return to Bacchusmon. ShogunGekomon then sings for everyone. Leopardmon enjoys it so much, he decides they need to preserve Digital World: Iliad.

Fertilizer for the Soul

Sirenmon, in sprout form, messages Yuki saying that there's a lot of hustle and bustle in the village and is missing out duel to being a sprout. Yuki visits, and Sirenmon talks about how she can hear the lovely singing from there — wishing she could hear it from closer up. Yuki says they'll bring the singers to her, which makes Sirenmon really happy. Yuki asks them to do so, though the thought of singing in front of Lady Sirenmon makes ShogunGekomon extremely nervous. He says he could probably do a passable showing, but thinks his bandmates aren't spirited enough. He sends out Yuki to find some Spirit Seeds, refusing to sing for Sirenmon without them. Yuki travels around the Forest and collects three of them, then gives them to ShogunGekomon — who then has his bandmates eat them. Now full of spirit, they go to Sirenmon and sing for her. She enjoys it so much, her sprout grows a Karpos Hulē. She allows Yuki to take it as thanks for bringing the singers to her.

The Pinnacle of the Card World

The Card King messages Yuki, saying it was time to determine who the true Card King was. He says to go to the Electric Town South Exit, in which Yuki duels and defeats him. Shocked, the Card King reveals he was actually Leopardmon and passes his title of King on the Yuki. He says he plans to remain there for a while so he can continue playing, and will go to the rendezvous point before the final battle. Yuki receives a message from an unknown sender, who praises them for their win and says they've earned the right to duel them. Yuki goes to Shinjuku as instructed, and learns the mystery sender was the one who had given them their first cards eight years before. He says he is the true Card King, and challenges Yuki to determine who the real true Card King is. Yuki defeats him as well, and becomes the new true Card King.

A Stubborn Fighter?

Gankoomon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki, saying he's bored as he had been waiting for Jesmon — who hadn't shown up despite having agreed to meet at the Paradise Colosseum. Yuki visits him, and he asks Yuki to tell Jesmon he's waiting if they find him — saying Jesmon had gone off to try ramen. Yuki is able to find Jesmon and send him to Gankoomon Yaro-Kei Ramen, with Gankoomon thanking them — not just for finding Jesmon, but for telling them where the rendezvous point was. Gankoomon says Yuki deserves a reward...with the reward being a fight against Gankoomon. He also tells Jesmon to fight alongside Yuki, as he wants to see if Jesmon got rusty. They defeat him, and Jesmon suggests for the two of them to go to the rendezvous point. Gankoomon laughs, and says he actually could've gone there at any point and hadn't because Alphamon had told him to stop acting as a Royal Knight. This confuses Jesmon, and when he asks why Alphamon said that — even Gankoomon had no clue. He says Alphamon had been talking about how he thought the human race didn't deserve to live, and he didn't know whether he should listen to Alphamon or King Drasil. He says he'll make his choice later, and asks Yuki and Jesmon to be there when he does.

Yaro-Kei Ramen

Jesmon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki, saying he keeps getting the wrong Yaro-Kei Ramen order. Yuki visits him, and notices he looks awful. He says he's hungry and is close to dying, and explains again about how he keeps getting the wrong order. He says his master must be furious as he's late, and becomes shocked when Yuki says they know Gankoomon. Yuki explains how neither he nor Jesmon had gone to the rendezvous point, and he says he'll go there after he eats the correct ramen. He asks Yuki if they know how to order it, and they teach him how to do so. Jesmon is finally able to order and eat the ramen, and gives Yuki a reward as thanks. He then leaves to meet up with Gankoomon.

Choosing a Human Representative!

Gankoomon messages Yuki asking for help, as his friend is in a real fix. Yuki goes to Akihabara and meets up with both him and Jesmon, with the two of them being in front of an Outer Dunegon. Gankoomon says his human friend is inside, and that he wants to check on him. He says he'll make his choice of how to side with based on how it goes, either with Alphamon — who was assessing the humans, or King Drasil — who wants to protect the humans. He took Jesmon and Yuki with him as they can act as witnesses representing the Digimon and Human sides. Once inside, Jesmon and Yuki learn it's a bar — whilst Gankoomon finds his friend flirting with a LadyDevimon waitress. She tells him to pay for his bill, though he isn't able to afford it and asks Gankoomon for money. Gankoomon is surprised his friend has no money as he won him a lot in the arena, and his friend says he already spent all that money in this bar. He says he'd messed up as the money was for his family, and asks Gankoomon to fix a fight in the arena so they can make lots of money together. Gankoomon says he's made his choice, and Jesmon begs him to reconsinder saying not all humans are are bad as him and that Yuki is a good human. He correct Jesmon and says he's chosen to protect humanity, and that it'd be more fun to train weak humans like this one instead of destroying them. Wanting to help his friend, Gankoomon says he'll destroy the bar — causing LadyDevimon to ask Kuzuhamon for help. They beat it up and leave the bar, with the human seemingly not paying his bill. Gankoomon asks if he's learned his lesson, and he says yes — though he also asks to borrow money to get the train home. Gankoomon agrees, though says he'll show up at his house when his family is home if he doesn't pay it back. After the man leaves, Gankoomon says he doesn't actually expect to get the money back but has still decided to side with humans. Gankoomon notes how much Jesmon had grown during the fight with Kuzuhamon, and says it's time for them to go to the rendezvous point.

Blink and You'll Miss It

Asuna Shiroki messages Yuki, asking for help as she and Monica Simmons had encountered an unidentified flying object in Akihabara. Yuki meets up with them, with Monica saying it might be a Digimon and Asuna saying that capturing it will be hard as it's so fast — which is why she called in Yuki. Moncia says it seems to be following a defined path, and that she's narrowed down multiple points they could intercept it meaning they'll need to split up. She says the most likely spots were the ramen shop and the Sorayodo model shop, and has Asuna go to the model store whilst she and Yuki go to the ramen shop (as she had already gone to the model store that day and wanted Asuna to learn how amazing it was). They wait a long time, but it doesn't show up. Yuki gets bored and demands ramen, whilst Monica decides to call Asuna over to the ramen store. Asuna says she had bought a large amount of action figures, as she had ended up falling to the store's allure like Monica had wanted. Kentaurosmon crashes into them whilst they were distracted, and they realise he was the unidentified object. Kentaurosmon meanwhile is angry at them for getting in the way of his restaurant tour. They fight, with Kentaurosmon impressed at them being able to defeat a Royal Knight. He assumes they're friends of King Drasil's due to their strength, with him mentioning his boss causing him to realise he was meant to be doing something else. He asks them where he was meant to go, and luckily for him — Yuki was indeed friends with King Drasil. Yuki tells him to go to the rendezvous point, and he remembers he already knew where that was. He gives them a reward and leaves, with Monica sad his tour was over and she wanted to suggest somewhere. Asuna then leaves, saying she needs to pick up her action figures.

The Beautiful Knight Corps

Dynasmon messages Yuki, saying that although he was at the rendezvous point — LordKnightmon wasn't, which he finds worrisome. Yuki goes to him, where he says LordKnightmon was meant to have arrived by now, and wonders if something had gone wrong in an investigation LordKnightmon was doing. He asks Yuki to go to Akihabara to find him, and Yuki finds him in front of an Outer Dungeon. LordKnightmon says his Knight Corps betrayed him and stopped following orders, and says he locked them inside the Dunegon. Kentaurosmon shows up and says he's not used to seeing LordKnightmon upset, and he agrees to help. Kentaurosmon says the Knights probably glitched because of the firewall in the human world, and that they're probably going to have to beat them up to bring them back to their senses. LordKnightmon had hope it wouldn't come to that, but ends up agreeing to fight them. The three of them go into the Dungeon, and kill them all. With that dealt with, LordKnightmon goes to the rendezvous point.

A Display of Beautiful Swordplay

Kentaurosmon messages Yuki, saying Dynasmon and LordKnightmon were arguing and it was annoying him. Yuki goes to them, and sees what they're arguing about. Dynasmon says LordKnightmon has no confidence in his swordsmanship, which is why he has his own army. LordKnightmon disagrees with this, and says he has the Knight Corps because it enhances his beauty. Dynasmon says Crusadermon had actually fallen behind his own minions in the way of the sword, that that was pathetic, and that he would've lost to his own minions had he and Yuki not been there. LordKnightmon says he will prove his strength by fighting Grademon, who is a renowned knight. LordKnightmon asks Yuki to go find Grademon, and Dynasmon tells them in secret that Grademon is at the Paradise Colosseum. Yuki tells LordKnightmon where Grademon is, and he leaves to go fight him. Dynasmon asks Yuki if he went too far, and Yuki says he did. He says he thought he hadand says he just wanted him to stop being so reckless. He sends Yuki after him, where Yuki finds Grademon having turned down a fight. Grademon says he has no reason to point his sword at him, and that he cannot fight a Royal Knight. Yuki says they have actually defeated Grademon before, and having heard this, LordKnightmon challenges them as defeating Yuki would mean he's also stronger than Grademon. Yuko defeats him, which upsets LordKnightmon — though he notes that Yuki is strong as they've defeated Grademon before. This being the case, it wasn't clear who was the stronger between them — leading him to ask Yuki who was stronger. Regardless of answer, LordKnightmon says he's satisfied and will return to the rendezvous point and make peace with Dynasmon.

Alpha and Omega

Agumon messages Yuki, saying to come to Central Tower so he can show all the Royal Knights that were there. Once Yuki arrives, Agumon celebrates at the fact that twelve of them (including himself and Gabumon as Omnimon) had gathered. They say may be able to save the World now, but Alphamon suddenly appears and says that he is not quite sure of that just yet. They're surprised to see Alphamon showing up, since he's the empty seat, and Alphamon says he is going to test Yuki's virtue as there's nothing worse than a flawed sense of justice. He finds humans disgusting, as they justify their cruel experiments on Digimon as research — but is aware there are some humans that reject that notion. As such, he wants to see if those specific humans deserve his trust. Agumon and Gabumon try to talk him out of it by saying there's good humans, but Alphamon refuses to back down and says that's what he's here to determine. Agumon and Gabumon become Omnimon and join Yuki's side, and Alphamon is fine with this — saying to prove their faith in humans to him. They defeat him, and he acknowledges the strong bond between humans and Digimon as well as the potential of humans. He agrees to a ceasefire, and says he will observe things quietly from here on — but also warns he will take action if the humans stray. He praises Omnimon for his stregnth, and says he managed to prove humanity's potential.

An Odd Letter

Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki, asking for advice as she got an odd letter. Once Yuki arrives, Hiroko shows the letter is from Kosuke Misono, and that it may be a faker since it's weird he would send a letter to his own office. She says there was a key inside for a coin locker in Shinuku Station, but was too scared to open it on her own. Once they open it, they find a machine part — and Hiroko is certain she's seen something like this before. She thinks back, and thinks she remembers seeing it at the site of the big disaster and that Kosuke appears to have stolen and hidden it since then. They travel to the site, where an Outer Dungeon suddenly appears. It sucks them in, where they're confronted by Machinedramon — who had finally located its missing part. The Royal Knights show up, saying they had sensed an immense power — and offer to help. There was only enough space for one of them though, so Yuki chooses one to aid in the fight. They defeat Machinedramon, who dies saying it'll return and will reborn as many times as needed. After the battle, Hiroko says it makes sense that Kosuke had looked into it since that's where his wife and son died — and wonders if he sent the part so that they could get revenge for him. Despite their current strained relationship, Hiroko says she still believes in Kosuke and rewards Yuki for the help.

Royal Knights' Test Match

Agumon messages Yuki, saying the Royal Knights had recovered most of their strength and to meet up with them. Yuki goes to them, where Agumon says they all want to fight Yuki. Yuki then fights them all in thirteen separate battles.

Olympos XII's Test Match

A Minervamon from an alternate world messages Yuki, saying she wants to talk to them in Akihabara. Yuki finds her in front of an Outer Dungeon, where she says she and the rest of the alternate world Olympos XII want to fight Yuki. Yuki goes inside and fights all of them at the same time.
sections.content_text: Mystery of the Missing T-Shirt Hiroko Sagisaka texts Yuki , saying that T-Shirts are going missing and to come to Kosuke Misono 's office as it may be an anomaly. She says it may be a ghost stealing them, since a human would've been caught by now, and so they should look into it. The owner of the shop says the shirts fly away on their own, and that it had actually happened just before they arrived. They follow a customer into an alley, who says he saw a monster go into the sewers with the T-Shirt. Inside, they find a ZubaEagermon wondering how it can make the stolen T-Shirts "scream Twentiest". Hiroko and Yuki confront him, and he asks them if they're Twentiest. They have no idea what tha means, and their answer on how to make the shirt Twentiest angers him. As such, Yuki and Aegiomon fight him. They defeat him and take all the stolen T-Shirts back, though Hiroko says they now have to figure out what Twentiest is. The shopkeeper thanks them for solving it, and says he'll give them discounts if they ever buy from him. The Targeted Cosplayer Hiroko Sagisaka texts Yuki , saying a cosplayer had gone missing in Shinjuku Park. Yuki, Hiroko, Aegiomon , and Minervamon go to the park, where Hiroko had agreed to meet with the cosplayer's friend. She explains how the friend had gone missing whilst cosplaying in the park, and Hiroko decides to recreate the moment by forcing Yuki to cosplay as one of the Chosen Children from Digimon Adventure (Kanan as Kari Kamiya , Dan as Taichi "Tai" Kamiya ). When Yuki starts walking around in the outfit, a portal opens and sucks them both in. They end up in the same place as the cosplayer, who tells them to get away before the monster returns. Tuskmon shows up and is happy at having finally caught a Tamer , and attacks them so they can't run away — saying their master would be mad if it lost the Tamer. After they kill Tuskmon, Hiroko asks if the cosplayer knows the master, though she says no as she only saw Tuskmon. As they wonder how they can return, they're sucked into another portal that takes them back. The cosplayer's friend thanks them for saving her, whilst Hiroko continues to wonder who Tuskmon's master was. Infinite Imagination Hiroko Sagisaka says she got a tip from a social media fan about an anomaly. The fan had created their own character, and that their character's data had disappeared one day. Shortly afterwards, they got messages telling them to go to a back alley in Akihabara . This scared them, hence Hiroko. They, Aegiomon , and Minervamon search around Akihabara, and eventually find a bunch of giant plastic blocks. When they try to investigate it, Shota Kuroi tells them to stay away as Public Security was already investigating it. He says they're not regular blocks, and that Monica Simmons ' device had gotten readings from it — as well as similar readings nearby. Unable to leave his post, he winds up agreeing to let them look around. They find two more blocks around Akihabara and return, which causes the bricks to combine and come to life as a giant ToyAgumon . ToyAgumon says it's lonely and wants to play — then attacks them. After they defeat it, it disappears. Shota says it's a strange dangerous creature that can't be allowed to roam free, which offends Hiroko since a kid made it. After Shota leaves to report what happened, Hiroko says the kid is lonely as has no friends and his parents are never around — hence why he made ToyAgumon. She then figured the kid's feelings effected ToyAgumon and that it didn't mean to rampage. To Do the Job, You Need to Dress the Part Asuna Shiroki puts out a message saying how many Public Safety staff had gone on leave, causing a staff shortage — and that she needed an energy drink. Yuki takes on the mission, and goes to Akihabara to find her — where Asuna complains about being overworked. Asuna is surprised someone took the request, and assumes she's hallucinating from too many energy drinks. Feeling it's fine to accept help sometimes, she has Yuki go with her to the underground. She has Yuki wear a Public Safety outfit so they can pass as actual staff, with Shota Kuroi annoyed she'd dragged a civilian in to help. An Outer Dungeon suddenly shows up in the middle of his complaining, and so the three of them go into it. They find two Bakemon inside, and defeat them. After the battle, Shota says if Yuki ever impersonates Public Safety again — he'll arrest them. He says he heard the government had sent agents to dig up info on Digimon, assumes Yuki is one of them — tells them to stay out of their business and says they will not be allies the next time they meet. The Secret Getaway Hiroko Sagisaka tells Yuki she got more information from social media, with people saying ghosts had been seen in Shinjuku Park. Asuna Shiroki approaches them whilst they're looking around the park and says they should stay away from the forest as she had heard an odd cry there the other day. Instead of heading the warning, Hiroko says she'll help out by using her camera — which Asuna agrees to since video footage may come in handy. Once there, they hear the cries — and quickly find they belong to a Guilmon . It's only able to say its own name, and despite that, Yuki is seemingly able to have a conversation with it by saying "Guil" a bunch of times. It runs into the sewers, with the others following it. When they find it, it attacks them. After defeating it, they note it seemed to just be playing with them and decide not to follow it further into the sewers since it didn't seem to be a threat. The Father of Shinjuku Hiroko Sagisaka tells Yuki she had managed to get a reservation with the famous fortune teller in Koshu-Kaido, and asks them to come with her. The fortune teller, known as "The Father of Shinjuku", does Hiroko's reading, and, aware she's a streamer, tells her she can achieve her dream and to be kind to everyone she meets...not just humans. After Hiroko leaves, he motions to do Yuki's fortune — only for Yuki to say they know he's not a human. He says his species isn't important, and that he knew Yuki would arrive today. He asks them to find four Digimon in the real world, as they had gotten lost and were unable to find their way home. He sends them them out to find them one by one, with Yuki's job made harder by the fact the four of them were disguised as humans. Yuki eventually tracks Gaomon , Lalamon , Bukamon , and Datamon down and takes them to fortune teller so he can send them back to Digital World: Iliad . As thanks for helping him, he reveals he's actually AncientWisemon in disguise — though Yuki isn't surprised. This annoys AncientWisemon, as he thought he'd done a good job pretending to be a human. Between the Worlds Hiroko Sagisaka texts Yuki saying she's located an anomaly in Akihabara and to meet there. Once there, Yuki finds not Hiroko, but Agumon , who was in front of an Outer Dungeon. He says he has lost Gabumon and was warned to prevent that from happening. He's surprised to see Yuki, but figures it's fine since they have their own Digimon. They go inside, and find Gabumon fighting an Orochimon . Now re-united, they Warp DNA Digivolve together into Omnimon then defeat it with Yuki's help. Once they come out of the Dungeon, they land right in front of Hiroko and Public Safety . Hiroko is annoyed Yuki went without them, and says she hadn't shown up because she had been caught by Public Safety. Yuki lies and says Agumon and Gabumon are their partners to try and keep them safe, but Agumon corrects them and says they already have a partner . He says they need to leave before they get in trouble with their boss , and the duo escape before they can be captured. Public Safety say trouble always happens around Yuki and Hiroko, and as such — they're going to keep a closer eye on the two of them. Hiroko and Asuna Shiroki bond over liking Agumon and Gabumon, leading an annoyed Shota Kuroi to remind her she's at work. Public Safety decide to look around for anything left behind — whilst Yuki and Hiroko leave. A Delayed Return A Hagurumon in Central Town says its colleague should be back by now, since the next shift should've started. Yuki overhears and asks what's wrong, with it saying that its friend may be in trouble...though it may also just be asleep since it's lazy. Since it's off duty and isn't allowed to do overtime, it asks Yuki to go check on it in its place. Yuki travels over to Central Tower , and finds the Hagurumon really was asleep. They wake it up, and it panics and leaves since it's not meant to be doing overtime. When Yuki returns, original Hagurumon thanks them for helping out. The Blacksmith's Request Zudomon asks Yuki to get him some materials from Central Tower . After Yuki gets them, he thanks them by allowing them to use his store. Knowledge Is the Death of Fear An Agumon texts Yuki , saying that some Digimon are scared of humans and that it will visit their house to talk about it. It shows up with Gatomon , who suggests the humans dress up as Digimon to try and make it easier for the scared Digimon to talk to them. Even Aegiomon has to, since they consider him a human due to how much time he spends with them. They go to Patamon and Palmon , who were scared of humans, and are able to befriend them — their Digimon costumes helping. Agumon and Gatomon then thank them for helping their friends get over their phobias. From Pegasusmon to the World Pegasusmon texts Yuki saying there's something it wants to do and that it needs their help. It says its there to encourage everyone, and that it needs to keep it up. Yuki notices Pegasusmon's worry, with Pegasusmon saying it can't be helped. Struggling to put its thoughts into words, it wonders if it can use its actions and asks Yuki for Digi-Eggs so its friends can digivolve and get stronger. Yuki has none, leading Pegasusmon to suggest asking Vulcanusmon to make them. He makes them for Yuki, and Yuki returns to Pegasusmon. Pegasusmon uses them on his friends, who Armor Digivolve. The four newly digivolved Armor Digimon join Yuki's party, with Yuki either leaving them in Central Town to protect it or taking them on their journey to fight the Titans . Back to the Skies Andromon talks to Yuki about how badly damaged Blimpmon is, and says it'll need a large amount of metal to fix him. Yuki asks the nearby Guardromon for metal, which it happily gives since it was thanks to them production was going smoothly again. Yuki gives it to Andromon, who then repairs Blimpmon. Quick to Fight, Quick on the Job Guardromon says to Yuki that the production lines are inoperative, and that the cause is insufficient material. It says LoaderLeomon is the one who moves production material from the mines, and that they've lost contact with it. It asks them to go and find LoaderLeomon and tell it the Titan issue is over and that it needs to deliver the Chrondigizoit Ore. Yuki goes into the mine and finds LoaderLeomon on a drilling rampage, and it attacks them thinking they're a Titan looking to stop its fun. Yuki tells it to contact Guadromon, and it does so saying Titans had shown up in the mine. Guadromon tells it about how the Titans were gone thanks to Yuki, and LoaderLeomon apologizes. They go to Guardromon with its drilled up metals, and says it's realized it's supposed to take the metal to the residents — not just spend all day having fun drilling. The Trial Solarmon talks to Yuki about how it can't get a Parrotmon plume for Bearmon from Central Tower because the Titans are in the way. It leaves for the tower, with Yuki following it. Yuki agrees to help, and finds one after defeating the Titans there. Solarmon thanks them, and gives them some items as a reward. The Craftsman's Partner Zudomon tells Yuki its hammer is broken, and asks them to get it some Chrondigizoit Metal so it can fix it. Yuki gets some from Guadromon, and gives it Zudomon. Zudomon uses it to fix its hammer. I Want to Go Someplace Legendary! With Blimpmon fixed, Coronamon says he wants to go on a trip to the Cosmic Area so he can train there and become strong. Blimpmon tells him he can't take him, as the area is the weather there is both too hot and cold. This relieves Lunamon and disappoints Coronamon. Yuki asks if there was any way he could go, with Blimpmon saying he'd be able to he it had a heater and a cooler. Yuki says they'll get them, with Blimpmon surprised at just how much they wanted to help Coronamon and Lunamon. He says there might be a cooler in the Factorial Area , with Yuki leaving to go find one. Yuki asks Vademon if he has any, and he offers to sell one for 10 million yen. Yuki is able to haggle the price down to 1000 yen, and buys it. They take it Blimpmon, who gets Datamon to install it. He says to tell Coronamon the good news, with a disappointed Lunamon saying guess we're going to Heat Cosmic . Coronamon surprises Lunamon and says he's going alone as only one Digimon can be the strongest. Lunamon protests, but Coronamon gets on Blimpmon before she can finish talking. Blimpmon then flies away. Lunamon worries about him, though quickly changes to anger and says she'll get Minervamon to beat him up when he gets back. Platinum Numemon's Jewelry Yuki comes across the Bearmon Brothers and Solarmon whilst in Central Town . Big Bearmon praises Solarmon, saying it brought him a plume, and that it's way cooler than Yuki — unaware it was actually Yuki who got the plume. He offers Yuki a chance to "redeem themselves", and that they're going to the underground to steal PlatinumNumemon 's jewelry. Once inside, the group beat up a group of Geremon under the mistaken assumption they were PlatinumNumemon. The actual PlatinumNumemon was watching the battle, with the group unaware. They look around for the jewelry, and find some cut glass. Solarmon and Little Bearmon think its treasure, though Big Bearmon is fully aware it's worthless and says they need the find the real jewelry. They say they're tired, and will just have to try again another day. They say they should ask at the tavern about the jewelry, and leave. Having heard this tip, Yuki goes there before them and talks to Deputymon about what happened. He tells them the Digimon they fought weren't PlatinumNumemon, and that the real one is Platinum and hangs out deep in the sewers. Yuki travels through the entire sewer, but is unable to find it...unaware it was following them the entire time. Yuki returns to the entrance, and just before leaving — turns around. They finally see PlatinumNumemon, and have their Digimon defeat it — acquiring the jewelry. Yuki shows off it off the trio, and Big Bearmon asks if he can have it. Yuki says they'll trade for it, and Big Bearmon offer to give them their special item for it — despite Little Bearmon's protests. Yuki then either does the trade, or gives it them for free. A Missing Friend Whilst in Central Town , Yuki sees a Motimon telling Agumon and Gabumon that its and its friends had been attacked whilst they were playing in the the Abyss Area . This caused them to get split up. Unfamiliar with Digital World: Iliad , they say have no clue what could've attacked them. Yuki asks if they can help, and they happily allow them to join the search. They go to to the Abyss Area, and find a Punimon being attacked by one of the remaining Titan — Scorpiomon . Agumon and Gabumon become Omnimon and defeat it with Yuki's help. Punimon thanks them for saving it, though quickly realises Motimon wasn't around. The group calm it down and take it to Central Town, reuniting the two baby Digimon. They offer them a reward, with the Yuki taking it since Agumon and Gabumon had no use for it. Agumon wonders what the Titans were up to, and he and Gabumon leave to look into it. Impatience and Determination Lunamon texts Yuki , saying she can't go on like this and to come talk to her. Blimpmon had returned from the Cosmic Area , but Coronamon hadn't — and Lunamon felt like she needed to take action. She says she needs to go to the Cosmic Area too, though decides she'd rather not go to the same place Coronamon went to — so decides to go to Chill Cosmic instead of Heat Cosmic. Blimpmon says he can't go as he doesn't have a heater, and has no idea where to get one. Yuki says they'll find one, and Blimpmon excitedly says he knows they'll be able to find one. Lunamon says she'll help look, and remembers seeing one inside one of of the houses in Central Town . Whilst checking houses, Yuki come across a Betamon who says its heater had been stolen by a Goblimon . Yuki says they'll track it down, though Betamon says it doesn't matter as it was faulty so it was just gong to buy a new one. Yuki finds a group of Goblimon in town and asks if one of them stole a heater, with the thief surprised Yuki knew. Yuki retries the heater and takes it to Blimpmon. Lunamo arrives and says she couldn't find one, though Blimpmon says it doesn't matter as it has one now. Blimpmon has Datamon fix it and install it, then takes Lunamon to Chill Cosmic. The Color the Water Speaks Of A Kamemon texts Yuki , saying they're all alone and is having trouble with something. It says it thinks the the Titans didn't leave because of Yuki, they probably left because they'd already achieved everything they wanted to. It notes the sea breeze smells different, and that Shellmon would know if something was up if she was here. They go to Shellmon's house in the hopes they could find a device to measure water quality. They find Shellmon's diary and end up reading it, with Kamemon finding an entry about water quality. If the plants are blue, it's fine — if they're purple, they're hurtful. It even says where the exact plants to check are. They go there, though Kamemon says it can't swim — meaning Yuki has to. Yuki swims through a group of Syakomon , and eventually finds the specific plant. It's purple, meaning the water is contaminated. This has it realize why the breeze smelled off, and it gives them items as thanks. It says it'll stay in the area and keep an eye on things. Divermon's Woes Divermon texts Yuki , saying how it was weird that Sharkmon backed down and that they should investigate the ocean floor. They travel around with the help of Submarimon, and find a spot where it's hard to breathe. They hear a voice saying to "give it back", and get attacked by a Crabmon who demands they return the current. Crabmon doesn't remember anything after the battle, and last remembered struggling to breathe. Divermon says he was right, and that he knew Sharkmon wouldn't have gone down quietly. He had clearly done something to the current. Divermon says his new plan was to become leader of the ocean Titans in Sharkmon's place, and that when becomes leader he'll order them to not cause any trouble. They then leave the area to avoid losing their minds like Crabmon had. Proper Beach Attire A Wanyamon from Central Town messages Yuki , saying they'd gone to the Abyss Area but that no one was there. When Yuki, Inori Misono , and Aegiomon arrive, it asks them to put on swimsuits and then swim in the ocean with it. They get changed and go there, but get attacked by a territorial Seadramon . After they win, it flees and says it's telling its boss. MegaSeadramon and WaruSeadramon show up, upset they had beat up Seadramon — and attack them assuming they're Titans . After losing, they also say they're going to tell their boss — though MetalSeadramon shows up and says they don't need to as Seadramon had already told it about the Titan invasion. It misunderstandings them wanting to have fun in the ocean as invading, and attacks them as well. Once defeated, MetalSeadramon surrenders and says the ocean is theirs. They turn it down and say they're not Titans, and tell them they're the ones who defeated the Titans in the first place. MetalSeadramon apologizes, and lets them play. They play together in the the water for a while, with Wanyamon rewarding them as thanks once they're done. Secret of the Hidden Honey Base A Muchomon texts Yuki , saying it had been attacked by bees. When Yuki goes to it, it says there's a hidden honey base belonging to the FunBeemon nearby, and that they had attacked it when it tried to steal some of the honey. It says there are probably Digimon scared of them, and then says the Titans were probably behind it and plan to immobilize everyone with FunBeemon. Yuki believes this, and Muchomon sends them to destroy the honey base. They destroy it, beat up all the FunBeemon, and return to Muchomon — who thanks them for doing so. The Mighty Bearmon Brothers The Bearmon Brothers message Yuki , saying they're going to patrol Gear Forest to keep it safe. Yuki travels there and finds them searching for Titans . Yuki tells them they had already defeated the Titans, which upsets the Bearmon Brothers. They decide the ones Yuki defeated were just small fry, and figure the real ones must be hiding somewhere. Big Bearmon runs off to go find the supposed bosses, leaving Little Bearmon behind since he was worried about them fighting the bosses. Little Bearmon asks for Yuki's help, and Yuki agrees. They search around and are actually able to find a member of the Titans, Minotarumon . After defeating it, Little Bearmon worries his brother was fighting one too — and so they look around for him. They find him fighting Greymon , another Titan, and help him defeat it. Big Bearmon says they aren't strong enough as they are right now, and Little Bearmon becomes upset realizing his brother doesn't want to be with him any more. Big Bearmon says there may be times they're not together, and so they need to be strong enough to fight by themselves. He has them promise that no matter what happens between them, they would meet again at the nearby tree. They thank Yuki for their help, and give them a reward. Yuki checks out the tree, and sees they had buried a note in a box saying the two brothers would bring peace to Digital World: Iliad together. Listen to the Voice JumboGamemon texts Yuki , saying its stuck in stuck in jail in the Abyss Sanctuary . When Yuki arrives, it says it was the Kamemon they knew eight years ago and had found a vein of Chrondigizoit Ore there but had also managed to get stuck in a Titan trap. It says it had tried to break out, but that the cell was too strong. Yuki realizes only Neptunemon could help, and says they'll go talk to him. JumboGamemon is happy to hear this, saying the other Digimon hadn't listened to him and had refused to help. Yuki explains this to Neptunemon, who is shocked to hear about such cells. He agrees to free it, and JumboGamemon is shocked they were able to get Neptunemon to come. He apologizes for not coming sooner, and frees it — also saying he was impressed it had found the ore. Neptunemon asks it to come with him, but it refuses as it doesn't trust him. Neptuemon promises to never have him go through something so bad again, and it decides to trust him. Neptunemon thanks Yuki, and rewards them. Message from Beyond Time Big Drimogemon and Little Drimogemon message Yuuki, saying they will defeat the Titans and make Gear Forest peaceful again. When Yuki goes to them, they talk about how they were inspired by the legendary Bearmon Brothers . They argue about if they should go left or right, and end the argument ends up so bad that they end their brothership. Yuki finds Little Drimogemon fighting a Groundramon and helps him defeat it. After the battle, Little Drimogemon says he's sad about the break up and leaves to go visit the Bearmon Brother's sanctuary to think. Yuki later finds Big Drimogemon fighting a WarGrowlmon , and helps him as well. He tries to celebrate the win with his brother, though ends up remembering he's not there. Sad, he too goes to the sanctuary. Yuki finds an ashamed Little at the shrine, with him saying the legendary brothers wouldn't want him there since he argued with his own brother. Big shows up, and Little tries to apologize. Big notices something buried in the ground before he can though, and the two brothers dig it up. They uncover the note the Bearmon Brothers had written eight years in the past, and figure it must've come to them as the the legendary brothers were telling them to always stick together. They make up and keep the note as a symbol of the lesson they learned from the legendary brothers. They then reward Yuki as thanks for helping them beat up some Titans. Hidden Honey Base Strikes Back Peckmon messages Yuki , saying the Gear Forest is in trouble because of the bees. When Yuki goes to Peckmon, it says it was the Muchomon who had asked them to deal with the FunBeemon eight years earlier. It shows Yuki a letter it got, which demands the one who destroyed their bases goes to the Shade Tree Pier so that they can get their revenge — and if they don't, the bees would attack the village. Peckmon had realized the bees weren't Titans , and says to try and sort things out with them. Yuki finds a TigerVespamon at the base, who was a digivolved FunBeemon that had been waiting to years get revenge. Yuki defeats it, and it submits itself to Yuki saying the strong controls the weak. Yuki tries to befriend it, though it refuses and instead decides to retire and move into the village. When they return to Peckmon, it says TigeVespamon showed up and asked to help rebuild the town and — and that Peckmon itself had apologised for assuming they were Titans and causing the entire issue. The Greatest OMNI Carnival Volcanomon invites Yuki and the others to the The Greatest OMNI Carnival tournament as it was impressed they were a double Champion. Yuki fights their way to the final, and eventually defeats Marsmon to become a triple champion. How to Cheer Up a Warrior Marsmon messages Yuki , asking what they should do with the Paradise Colosseum now Callismon was gone. When Yuki visits him, he says how sad he was about having to defeat his brother and asks what humans do to help them feel better. Yuki suggests watching a movie, and takes Marsmon to Hiroko Sagisaka . She suggests the movie "Yesterday's George", which is a boxing movie where the boxer nearly kills his opponent. Marsmon relates to this, and says he can bounce back like the boxer had. He decides to go back to the underground Colosseum, and challenges Yuki to a fight when they arrive. Yuki wins, and Marsmon realizes he's too scared to use his full strength after using it to defeat his brother. Worrying about it makes him hungry, and they agree to eat together. They eat lots of food together, which makes him feel better. He remembers his brother once saying you can't protect Digital World: Iliad on an empty stomach, and feels like he can fight again. He challenges Yuki again, and says to go to the Paradise Colosseum when they're ready for a proper rematch. Stuck in the Restroom A clerk at the coffee shop messages Yuki , saying someone had locked themselves in the toilet and was muttering about their captain and a weapon. Yuki says they're certain they know who it is, and is proven right when it's Shota Kuroi . They hear his complaints and knock on the door, and he recognizes Yuki's voice. Despite telling Yuki to go away, he opens up to them and talks about how much hates Digimon due to what happened to Kodai Kuremi . Yuki tries to calm him down, but he says how nothing will change his mind and that he had agreed to pilot a weapon that will let him get revenge against Digimon. He's surprised when Yuki show concern for him, and says he'll take their words into consideration. Talking about it helped him feel better, though he says it changes nothing and they're still enemies. He refuses to leave still, and Yuki leaves the shop. Seconds later, the clerk stops them says the guy came out and had asked him to give Yuki a reward as thanks. In the Palm of an Unknown Hand Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki , saying she got a creepy messages and to meet her in Higashi-Shinjuku. When they get there, she says the messages asked her to to sneak into a D-SAT vehicle and that she felt like the person had been watching her the entire time. This is proven true when she receives a new message saying to tell Yuki to dress in something cyber. Yuki puts on the same outfit Aiba wears, and they get a new message telling them to pick up an ID card and a USB drive from nearby. After they get them, they get a message telling them to get into the D-SAT vehicle in Shinjuku Park. Once they arrive, they see D-SAT staff and assume they have no chance of getting in — only to see the staff leave after getting reports that Digimon had escaped from the Digimon District. They use Kodai Kuremi 's ID to get into the vehicle, then insert the USB into the computer inside after being told to do so in another message. The computer loads data about an upcoming project created by Jindai Technology , Project EDEN — as well as diary entries from a scientist who hates Yuya and Monica Simmons . Once done, they're told to leave the ID and USB on the bench nearby and that their reward is also there. Once they leave, a pleased Kyoko Kuremi says how that'll clear things up and will help her learn what "you know who" had been up to. She then leaves as well. The Easy Road Is Best ZubaEagermon messages Yuki , saying it was confused as it still doesn't know what "Twentiest" means and asks them to visit them in a back alley in Shinjuku . Yuki says they don't know the answer either, and it says it feels like its road to the Twentiest is gone as it doesn't know what's "in" any more. It says it's annoyed at being normal, and that the Twentiest is supposed to stand out. They mention how Yuki stands out due to their silly outfit, then realizes that helped them get closer to being the Twentiest. They ask to see more of Yuki's clothes, and specifically request clothes with Digimon on them. Yuki puts some on, and ZubeEagermon loves them so much it declares their outfit is Twentiest. It realizes being Twentiest is having extra flair that goes beyond normal fashion, and says it had been trying too hard — the more you try to be Twentiest, the further away from it you get. Having finally realized what the Twentiest is, it digivolves to Duramon . It says being normal is fine, and then says it's to going to the arena in the Factorial Area . When Yuki visits, it says it had put in "normal" effort for "normal" wins, but found it boring. It de-digivolves back to ZubaEagermon, and says it will step away from the path of the normal and will try to stand out again. It digivolves again, this time to Grademon — and says it has rediscovered the path of the Twentiest. It challenges Yuki to battle, and asks them to fight it in the Paradise Colosseum when they're ready. I Don't Belong Anywhere Yet MarineAngemon messages Yuki , saying that no one in the Warrior's Watering Hole respects their cuteness and that someone needs to heal their weary spirit. When Yuki visits, it says that it had wanted to be a star across the entirety of Digital World: Iliad , but that no one cared and it missed the ocean. It asks Yuki to bring it a bottle of ocean water, and so Yuki goes to the Abyss Area and gets some. Regardless of the water Yuki gets, MarineAngemon hates it as it's not from the depths. MarineAngemon runs away, and when Yuki finds it it says it'll return to the sea as that's where its fans are. When Yuki returns to the Abyss Area, they see the residents fawning over delighted MarineAngemon. It thanks Yuki and rewards them, as they were the one who got convinced it to return. A Gift from the Hosts Mirei messages Yuki ; saying King Drasil , Homeros , and Kunlun want to talk to them. Yuki goes to the In-Between Theater and visits them, with them giving Yuki the power to time travel to any time and place they had been to before. They say they did this because Yuki had had some difficulties recently and that it would help them prepare for the battle agaisnt Chronomon . Longing for Akihabara Yuki time travels to the past, and receives a message from Vulcanusmon who says he had got a part from an excellent action figure but that he needed advice about it. He shows them the action figure hand, and asks them to go to Akihabara to find a figure from the same series as that one. He gives them the hand and a receipt that was with it, and when Yuki goes to the store they run into Monica Simmons . She's surprised to learn that Yuki is into action figures as well, and becomes even more surprised to see them with the hand of a figure from a limited edition Sayori Magical Girl figure. Yuki says why they were actually there, and Monica suggests a specific Sayori figure saying their client would love it. Yuki tries to buy it, though when the clerk says it's ¥600,000 they protest and say it's too much. Monica steps in and says she'll buy it for them if it's for a Digimon, and asks them to explain one day why they needed it. Yuki takes the figure to Vulcanusmon, who is delighted with it. Final Battle Challenger Merukimon messages Yuki , asking them to visit him as he has a problem. When they arrive, they see Pharaohmon and Rapidmon (Armor) begging to be in the front lines for the next battle as they had been unable to help retake Central Town — with Merukimon apprehensive. He asks Yuki to talk to them, and they say they became strong by living in harsh conditions and rescuing Digimon from the Titans, but wanted to become stronger as they had struggled in their battles against said Titans. Though he was moved by their words, he was worried about letting them join as he didn't know their strength as well as the upcoming battle being more dangerous than any other. Yuki suggests testing their strength in the colosseum, and Merukimon agrees and tasks Yuki to do it as he is too busy to do it himself. After the battle, regardless of Yuki's answer, they say they're joining the fight — with this annoying Merukimon. He no longer minded though, as he had seen they were strong enough to put up a decent fight against Yuki. Memories of Bonds A cosplayer messages Yuki saying there's two amazing cosplayers in Akihabara and that they should go see them. Once Yuki meets up with the cosplayer, they point them in the direct of the two amazing ones and Yuki goes to find them. Yuki finds them and learns they're not cosplayers, it's just Asuna Shiroki and BeelStarmon . Yuki eavesdrops on their conversation, where the duo reminisce about how BlackGatomon digivolved to BeelStarmon in response to Asuna becoming her friend. They also talk about how much they've improved each other. They notice Yuki had been eavesdropping, and say how Yuki was actually part of that moment too — and so thank them as they helped them to become friends. A Stubborn Fog Yuki time travels to the past, and receives a message from a Punimon who says the fog was so bad it got scared and returned to Gear Forest . It asks for help to get through it, and asks them to talk to Cherrymon . Yuki asks Cherrymon to remove the fog, but it refuses. Yuki attacks and defeats Cherrymon, though it still refuses.
