Sirenmon shows up and asks what's going on, with Cherrymon saying it was doing as it was told as Sirenmon had told it not to let anyone through. Sirenmon says she had already told it that Yuki and the others are her guests, and as such should be allowed through. Cherrymon remembers this, and says he hadn't recognised them because of the fog. A tremor happens, with Sirenmon saying it was as she feared and that Cherrymon had put the fog up as she was worried about intruders. They travel further in, and find a MegaKabuterimon on a rampage due to the Current's powers. It comes to its senses after they beat it up, and Sirenmon performs a ritual to safeguard the area. Encounters beyond Space-Time Mirei Mikagura tells Yuki that a powerful Digimon from another World had started to encroach this one and asks them to defeat it. She sets up an Outer Dungeon they can use to travel there. Dreams or Reality? Yuki collects Hiroko Sagisaka 's monikers. Some are in the present, and some are in the past. All Eyes on Me! Etemon asks Yuki to time travel to eight years ago and collect his Soul Bits. Yuki does so. Silent Envy Monica Simmons tells Yuki that Toya Kuga released a bunch of Kuramon in Tokyo , and asks them to defeat them all. Yuki does so. Each of them has a Core Dump, which have Kuga's thoughts inside. What Is Love? Minervamon messages Yuki , wondering about if love can change a person — and asks Yuki to come talk to her in Central Town . They go to Minervamon's house, where she brings up Junomon going crazy due to love. She doesn't understand the concept, and wonders if people change when they have feelings for someone. She says she doesn't want to change by falling in love, and so needs to learn what it is before it could change her. As humans know the most about love, she says they should talk to an expert — and suggests Hiroko Sagisaka . Hiroko says it's hard to explain, and that even psychologists and philosophers don't have the answer. She says how each person has their own form of love, and that that means she'd have to study lots of love not just one. She suggests watching romance movies, and they watch one about a motorcycle thief. Though she didn't really get the movie, she thought the guy riding a motorcycle was cool and that's what she'd like it to be like if she ever fell in love as shed didn't think it would change her. Whilst she still didn't understand love, she did gain a new appreciation for movies and thanks Yuki for helping. Premonitions of Love Minervamon still doesn't understand love, and asks Yuki to come talk to her in Rebellion Village. She says she finds human love insignificant, and that there's no reason to let it dictate your actions. Though she found human love boring, she excitedly says they need to look into love between Digimon and asks Yuki to let her know if they find a worthy Digimon. She asks them to find a Digimon as cool as the motorcycle hero from the movie she saw, and asks them to talk to the nearby Tanemon as it must know loads about Digimon since it was playing the Jogmon card game. Tanemon show off its Beelzemon card, and says it's the only Digimon known to ride a motorcycle ( Behemoth ). Yuki brings their own Beelzemon to Minervamon, who is speechless when seeing it riding its own Behemoth. She leaves to clear her head, and says how she felt strange and crazy. When Yuki goes back to her, she says she felt something warm in her chest — as well as tightness and pain — and says she's going to stay in the village to figure out what it is. Triumph is Mine Minervamon says she needs to do something about the feeling, and asks Yuki to come talk to her in Rebellion Village. When Yuki does, Minervamon demands they fight her. She says she's felt weird ever since seeing Yuki's Beelzemon , and, unable to to put it into words, decided she needed to fight Yuki. She figures beating Yuki would put her mind at ease, as Yuki hangs out with tough Digimon — though ends up being defeated. She complains about the loss, and says she needs to get stronger before the battle against Chronomon . She says her feelings held her back, and so she needs to shut herself away until she becomes stronger. Something surges within her, and she thinks she's about to digivolve... but then nothing happens. It helped clear her mind though, so she thanks Yuki and gives them a reward. Minervamon's Decision Minervamon messages Yuki , saying she needs to tell them about something that's bothering her and to meet her at her house in Central Town . She says she heard the Beelzemon of the Seven Great Demon Lords was near the Factorial Area , and asks Yuki to go with them to see. They find him, and he says he would usually kill them — but can't as his guns and Behemoth are out of commission. Yuki suggests attacking Beelzemon whilst he was weakened, but Minervamon refuses as she wouldn't be satisfised with a win like that. They offer to help fix them, so that they can fight him in a fair battle. He agrees, and they get the materials for him. He fixes them, then fights them in the coliseum as Beelzemon BM. Minervamon and Yuki win, and Beelzemon leaves as promised. Minervamon says she feels a weight has been lifted as she no longer finds herself admiring another and says she needs to better herself. She then thanks Yuki for their help and gives them a reward. The Helper from Shambala Kunlun messages Yuki and asks them to come visit him. When Yuki does, he explains that he's the Host Computer of Digital World: Shambala and that the Digimon he brought with him — Susanoomon and a few others — hadn't been in contact lately and that they seem to be having too much fun in Digital World: Iliad . He says they went to the Paradise Colosseum to train, and asks Yuki to go there and remind them of their mission. The Forgetful Helpers Yuki goes to the Paradise Colosseum and finds three of Kunlun 's helpers, Kotemon , Musyamon , and Zanbamon . Yuki mentions they were sent by Kunlun, and they remember they hadn't been in contact for a while. They say they had come to train and had just lost track of time, an figure Yuki must be a strong warrior from Digital World: Iliad to have been sent by Kunlun. As they find the Colosseum too fun, they refuse orders and say they'll only listen if Yuki can defeat them in battle. Yuki defeats them, though they say it isn't over as they still need to defeat Susanomon . Susanomon the Hero Yuki defeats Susanomon , and so, as agreed, it, Kotemon , Musyamon , and Zanbamon contact Kunlun and leave to join the Royal Knights at Central Tower . Scariest Face in the World Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki , saying she got a tip about a missing person's case and asks them to come and help her with it. She says a girl named Kurumi messaged her, with them reading her email to see that her Instructor Saburo Miura had gone missing. She says there's a ghost story at her school that claims there's a red book in the library that you can't stop reading once you start it. Once you finish it you feel a tap on the back, then see the scariest face in the world when you turn around. This caused all the students to become scared of reading, which upset Mr Miura. To try and prove the story wrong he read the book, which was about his own life. This scared him, and he continued to read — even refusing to return to class so he could finish the book. She says there were sightings of him at Shinjuku Park, with the witness reports saying he was still reading the book. Yuki suggests going to the park, but Hiroko turns them down saying she wants to look into something first. Hiroko goes on her own, and finds the book on the bench. She starts reading it, with the book being about her own life as well. Hours later, when Hiroko finishes the book, a man appears behind her. The Operator contacts Yuki and says they had been tracking Hiroko, and that she had just gone into the sewers after spending hours at Shinjuku Park. Yuki goes to where Hiroko's signal vanishes, and finds and Outer Dungeon. Once inside, Yuki finds a Wendigomon with lots of humans. It admits to having made the book, says how much fun it was to scare humans — and that it is able to harvest lots of energy from them. It attacks Yuki, though is defeated. Yuki saves them, and Hiroko admits she was captured on purpose as that was the quickest way to be able to solve it. They return all the humans to the human world, where they lie to Miura and say they and Kurumi found him passed out. He thanks them for their help, and he goes home to rest. Kurumi then thanks them for their help. Fulfilling a Great Ambition Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki , saying there's someone she wants them to meet. Once Yuki arrives at the detective agency, she introduces them to Norio — a supposed time traveller from the past. He says he originated from eight years ago, and was caught up in an explosion (the same one that sent Yuki eight years into the future as well). Since the same thing happened to Yuki, Hiroko figured they were the best person for the job. Yuki takes him to Mirei Mikagura , who confirms he had indeed travelled in time — and attempts to send him back to the past. Instead of return to the past, he and Yuiki end up in an Outer Dungeon. Millenniummon refuses to let him return to his own time, and attacks him — though Yuki is able to defeat it and protect him. Defeated, Millenniummon says it will let him alone — but still plans to enjoy itself. Yuki takes Norio to the past, then returns to the present. Norio from the present shows up, and says he thinks the young version of himself will show up again and that he had actually visited his future self before going to Hiroko. This had caused issues, as the original present version of Norio was a rich successful business man that was married to Hanae — the girl he had a crush on — and that the current version was a broke single man as he had assumed his life would be successful so partied instead of working hard. He asks them to help him fake their meeting, as past Nori seeing current would cause the timeline to shift even further and cause current Norio to cease to exist. They rent a suit and convince Hanae to pretend she's married to him, which she agrees to as she thinks it'd be fun to pretend she's a private investigator. Past Norio is impressed, though Hanae bursts the bubble and says she can't do it any more — admitting the truth. Present Norio explains what happened, and a distraught past asks to return to the his own time period. Before Yuki can do so, Hiroko brings up that the entire situation was weird — Yuki and Inori Misono disappeared for eight years, whist Norio didn't. Millenniummon, who had seemingly been watching everything, says Hiroko was smart to notice — and summons everyone back to the Outer Dunegon. It says it had taken an interest in Norio, and that what she mentioned had happened as it messed with space-time to allow it. Not wanting its fun to be over, it attacks them again — but is defeated again. It begs to be killed, though both Norio say it's fine and they didn't mind what had happened and even saw it as a pleasant experience. Millenniummon apologizes, and tells the past Norio to live a good life. Yuki has Mirei send him to the past again, where he says he will make sure not to become a loser in the future. When Yuki returns to the present, the timeline changes again — this time, they actually are married and Norio was a successful businessman. Observing the Underworld Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki , saying she found a picture of herself from high school and that they should come reminisce with her over it. It's a picture of her class, and she recognises and realises that Kinshiro Eriito — a guy who once asked her to help find his parents — was in her class back then. She wasn't able to help him, and says she wishes they could go back in time as she thinks Yuki would be able to help find them. Yuki travels back in time eight years, and goes to Shinjuku Park — where Hiroko had said she'd met up with him back then. Yuki finds Kinshiro, and the teenage Hiroko is surprised to see Yuki was already there. They both explain that he's a genius, and they explain that he had never met his parents — he was a designer baby made through donated DNA. Kinshiro mocks regular humans, and compares them to primates — saying he only goes to high school because he wanted to study dumb people and see how they live in such squalor. Hiroko mentions Monica Simmons is likely familiar with the lab, and they track her down with the help of Asuna Shiroki . They find her being attacked by a group of Piximon , leading Yuki to save her. They explain Kinshiro story to her, and she says the data is probably top secret and thus they'll have to hack to get access to it. Kinshiro says he already tried and that his computer wasn't powerful enough, and she says it's fine as they can use hers and she wanted to look into them anyway as she's heard they're doing illegal genetic modifications. She performs the hack, and and tells him that his parents were chimpanzees. This upsets him, since it means he can't talk to them. That's not all though, Kinshiro will eventually turn into a chimpanzee. After he ran away, Hiroko asks how long he has — and she says in eight years he'll be a full primate. Yuki returns to the present, and finds a human Kinshiro in Seibu-Shinjuku. Kinshiro recognises Yuki, and says he and some others found a way to have him remain human. Doing so helped him learn to appreciate others, and he ended enjoying meeting his parents. As thanks for helping out eight years ago, he gives them a reward. Royal Knights, Assemble! King Drasil messages Yuki , saying she needs their help. Yuki travels to the VIP room of the In-Between Theater, in which King Drasil is with Agumon and Gabumon . They mention to King Drasil how they were already familiar with Yuki, and how strong they are — saying they can help them for sure. She says she was in Digital World: Iliad as it was in trouble, and that she had brought the Royal Knights with her. As they were unfamiliar with this world, they all got lost — and as such, she asks Yuki to go find them all and get them to gather at Central Tower . She says it will be hard, as she had given them human forms — and Yuki goes to the rendezvous point with Agumon and Gabumon (who are one of the Royal Knights as Omnimon ). They give Yuki some supplies, then send them off to find their allies. Knowing One's Strength Craniamon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki , saying he was at Central Tower but that he wasn't sure of himself as everyone in Digital World: Illiad was strong. Yuki finds him wounded, and he explains he had fought enemies on the way there. He asks if Yuki thinks he can be of use in his current state, and Yuki suggests to ask a fortune teller. They go to the one in Shinjuku , who was actually AncientWisemon (though Craniamon was unaware of this). He tells Craninamon (who was in his human disguise) to go to subroad, and that he will get his answer from a man there that is eating a crepe. They travel there, and the man says it must be Digimon related when he mentions he was sent by a fortune teller. They explain how Craniamon had lost his confidence, and the man says how he knows that the "human" was Craniamon. He says the best way to deal with it is to challenge the strongest Titan — Plutomon . They travel to the Dark Field together, where Craniamon challenges Plutomon. He turns it down, and says he cannot fight a Royal Knight as everyone would take it too seriously. He instead tells Craniamon to challenge Enbarrmon, the immortal steed, and says he'll personally take him to Enbarrmon as fate had brought them together. Crainamon thanks Yuki for their helpp, and says he's going to go fight Enbarrmon. Showdown with the Immortal Steed Yuki , Craniamon , and Plutomon challenge Enbarrmon — the goal being helping Crainamon to win so he can regain his confidence. They defeat it, and Enbarrmon says it enjoyed the battle. Plutomon says that means it considers Craniamon worthy, and Enbarrmon proves this by allowing Craniamon to ride it. This causes them to become Craniamon + Enbarrmon, with Craniamon happy as the addition of flight has him feeling more powerful. Yuki reminds him to go to the rendezvous point, and so he does so — taking his new steed with him. Plutomon was also happy, as it meant the rampaging Enbarrmon had been dealt with. Secrets Are for Sharing A Bakemon messages messages Yuki , saying something scary was happening in Plutomon 's castle and that it was too scared to investigate itself. Yuki meets up with it, and it says it senses a powerful aura inside the castle. Once Yuki goes inside, they see Plutomon having a meeting with Imperialdramon FM . Imperialdramon says that it was actually the "human" who helped them with Craniamon , and that it was returning to the human world as it knew Dark Field was safe in Plutomon's hands. Plutomon had actually sent Imperialdramon as an undercover agent, his mission being to protect the human world...though Imperialdramon only really cared about the human world's sweets. Imperialdramon invites Yuki to a sweets festival, and Plutomon notices Yuki's disappointment over non-seriousness of their conversation. Yuki returns to Bakemo and says it had sensed Imperialdramon, and it says it's glad Plutomon is okay. One Shield Maker's Struggle Gallantmon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki , saying he had gone to Factorial Town to repair his equipment. Yuki goes to him and reminds him he needs to go to the rendezvous point, but he says he can't as his equipment got destroyed by a firewall. He came to this area to get Chrondigizoit to fix it, but noticed the area was crawling with evil Digimon. Not wanting to damage his equipment even further, he asks Yuki for help. They go into the mines, and find a rampaging Chaosdramon in the way. It refuses to leave, wanting all the Chrondigizoit for itself — and so the two of them beat it up. Chaosdramon runs away, allowing Gallantmon to use the Chrondigizoit to repair its equipment. Chaosdramon shows up and attacks them again, wanting revenge — but loses even quicker than last time thanks to Gallantmon being back at full strength. He thanks Yuki for their help and agrees to go to the rendezvous point after giving Yuki a reward. Veemon's Growth Veemon messages Yuki , saying he was in the sanctuary in Gear Forest with a human hating WereGarurumon . Yuki goes to them, and WereGarurumon says it knew a human would show up eventually and that humans were dangerous if they could sense the area's energy. Veemon says WereGarurumon is being too negative, but WereGarurumon says Veemon just doesn't understand and that he should talk to Yuki as they're a human to learn what humans are like. After WereGarurumon leaves, Veemon asks if humans are dangerous, though says he'll just go to the human world and decide himself if it was actually true. He says for Yuki to take him somewhere that'll help him understand humans, and so Yuki takes him to various restaurants. Veemon is happy with this, as the best way to learn people's culture is through your stomach — and eats some ice cream. Veemon loves it, and says he's happy to have learned about humans. They go back to the sanctuary, where Veemon digivolves to Magnamon and says he was actually one of the Royal Knights . He loved the ice cream so much he decides he wants to defend humanity, and says he's going to go to the mines to refine his armor. He then thanks Yuki for their help. Bring Your Own Materials Magnamon messages Yuki , saying he was in Factorial Town and needed help fixing his armor. Yuki visits him, and he says he travelled here as he needed Chrondigizoit Metal to repair his armor. There was an issue though... and Guardromon explain there was currently a shortage Chrondigizoit Ore — one of the materials used to make the Metal. LoaderLeomon 's mine hadn't got enough lately, and so Guadromon says it'll take them to a different mine and that they can go mine in there and help out. Though he would usually do it by himself, Magnamon asks Yuki to help as he wants to guarantee success. They find some, and get attacked by an angry Breakdramon who accuses them of stealing it. It doesn't care that Mangamon got permission, and says it all belongs to it. Yuki fights it, and tells Magnamon to repair its armor whilst they do. Magnamon repairs his armor and joins the fight half way in, and helps them to defeat it. Magnamon then thanks them for their help. The Call of the Unseen Examon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki , saying he was at Central Tower but that no one could see him. Once Yuki goes there, they hear a buzzing sound and assume its a fly (it's a mini Examon). The "fly" continues to make sounds, though Yuki is only able to hear parts of what mini Examon is saying. Examon is eventually able to get through, and introduces himself. He says he was always told he was too big, so made himself smaller — but went overboard. Unable to fix it, he asks Yuki for help. Yuki mentions a growth medicine, and Examon demands Yuki take him to some. Yuki takes him to Venusmon , who actually has said medicine... though shes unable to see Examon. She scatters it all over in the hopes some would land on him, and some does — making him slightly bigger. Venusmon is now able to see him, and they leave her house so they can continue increasing his size. As he gets bigger, a HerculesKabuterimon and its minions show up and attack Examon. The trio defeat the Titans , and Examon returns to his regular size after the battle. Now back to his regular size, he thanks Yuki and goes to the rendezvous point. The Worthy UlforceVeedramon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki , saying he went to the Abyss Santuary to repair his armor but that he doesn't know how to get a meeting with Neptunemon . Yuki meets up with him, where he says he had wanted to talk to Neptunemon as he had Blue Digizoid armor — but that he knows its a rare material and so he'd seen suspicious by wanting it. Yuki offers to introduce them, and takes him to Neptunemon. UlforceVeedramon explains the predicament, and Neptunemon says he uses the Chrondigizoit vein shown to him by JumboGamemon to repair his armor. UlforceVeedramon asks if he can have some, though Neptunemon says he can't just give it to anyone. UlforceVeedramon takes this as a test to prove himself, which Neptunemon confirms. He challenges UlforceVeedramon to battle, though says they should go somewhere else to even things out as he has the advantage underwater. UlforceVeedramon doesn't mind, though Neptunemon insists on a fair battle and allows Yuki to join in as that'd even things out. They defeat Neptunemon, and he acknowledges the knight's strength and agrees to share the Ore with him. He sends JumboGamemon to Factorial Town to process it, and asks Yuki to return after they've finished helping UlforceVeedramon. They go to Factorial Town, where UlforceVeedramon gets the metal. He thanks Yuki for their help, then goes to the rendezvous point. To My Dearest Neptunemon messages Yuki , saying he still has some Blue Digizoid left over and wants to ask a favor from them. Once Yuki arrives, he says he made a ring with the left over Blue Digizoid from when they fixed UlforceVeedramon 's shield, and says he heard humans give rings to the one they find the most dear. Yuki confirms this, and Neptunemon says he wants to give it to Venusmon as thanks for returning his scarf. Rather than give it himself though, he asks Yuki to take it to her. Yuki travels to Central Town and gives it to her, and she's surprised to receive such a precious gift. She thinks, then remembers about Neptunemon telling her about Christmas and assumes it must be a Christmas present. She gives Yuki some medicine, and says to take it to Neptunemon as her Christmas present to him. Yuki takes it to him, and he's confused to receive it. Despite her seemingly not understanding his expression of gratitude, he still found himself satisfied — then says he tends not to understand his own feelings as well and had made the ring without thinking. Duels Must Be Fair Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki , saying she got a sus tip about Phase Electron Lifeform sightings. When Yuki goes to her, she says she finds the tipster more suspicious than the tip itself and says it was about a strange cosplayer in Higashi-Shinjuku. They wonder if the tipster was Kosuke Misono , with Hiroko also wondering why a Digimon would disguise itself as a human. Finding it interesting, she asks Yuki to meet up at the Koma Theater Square where the cosplayer had been seen. Upon arrival, they see Dynasmon being mocked by humans. This angers him, with him thinking they had no chivalry. Hiroko says he had been challenging people to duels for a while, but that no one had taken him seriously. She suggests for Yuki to talk to him, though says to be careful as it'll probably end up in a duel challenge. This is proven true, as Dynasmon challenges Yuki within seconds. Yuki accepts, and defeats Dynasmon. After the battle, Dynasmon notices something was amiss — and a Megadramon spawns. Dynasmon says he wont be able to defeat it alone, and asks for Yuki's help. They defeat it, and after the battle — he praises Yuki's stregnth and says they are worthy of carrying out King Drasil 's orders (showing he knew who Yuki was the whole time). Satisifed, he leaves to go to the rendezvous point. Hiroko praises their fightings skills as well, and wonerrs again about why Kosuke would send her the tip. She figures he was testing her, and that he would've had other ways to deal with it had she failed. She then gives Yuki a reward for helping. A Facilitator's Woes A Lalamon messages Yuki , saying it was relaxing in the Shaded Woods and saw a strong Digimon show up. Yuki shows up, and the Lalamon says they should leave as the strong Digimon was rampaging. Yuki asks if it was a Titan, though it says no and that the strong Digimon was beating up Titans too. Despite the warning, Yuki goes further into the forest and is attacked by Leopardmon LM — who says he was annoyed by everyone being selfish and that he cannot please everyone. Leopardmon snaps out of it after the battle, and thanks Yuki for stopping him. He Mode Changes into regular Leopardmon , and introduces himself as the leader of the Royal Knights . He clarifies he was upset at them, as he had tried to assemble them but they had all scattered everywhere. He had ended up alone and became one with nature, which caused him to lose track of time. Yuki relays King Drasil 's message about the Knights going to Central Tower , but Leopardmon says he doesn't feel confident about his leadership skills at the moment so will go there after some time spent reflecting. He then gives Yuki a reward for helping him remember his true goals. Find a Lead Vocalist! Bacchusmon messages Yuki , saying a band would make the party more lively. Yuki visits him, where a Kabuterimon mentions having a choir but not lead vocalist. Bacchusmon says ShogunGekomon is perfect for that role, and sends Yuki out with the mission to convince him to sing. Leopardmon also decides to help search, as his prowess as a lead vocalist intrigues him. They both find him in the sanctuary, and find him fighting a GranKuwagamon . They defeat it, and and ask him to join the band. He agrees, and they all return to Bacchusmon. ShogunGekomon then sings for everyone. Leopardmon enjoys it so much, he decides they need to preserve Digital World: Iliad . Fertilizer for the Soul Sirenmon , in sprout form, messages Yuki saying that there's a lot of hustle and bustle in the village and is missing out duel to being a sprout. Yuki visits, and Sirenmon talks about how she can hear the lovely singing from there — wishing she could hear it from closer up. Yuki says they'll bring the singers to her, which makes Sirenmon really happy. Yuki asks them to do so, though the thought of singing in front of Lady Sirenmon makes ShogunGekomon extremely nervous. He says he could probably do a passable showing, but thinks his bandmates aren't spirited enough. He sends out Yuki to find some Spirit Seeds, refusing to sing for Sirenmon without them. Yuki travels around the Forest and collects three of them, then gives them to ShogunGekomon — who then has his bandmates eat them. Now full of spirit, they go to Sirenmon and sing for her. She enjoys it so much, her sprout grows a Karpos Hulē. She allows Yuki to take it as thanks for bringing the singers to her. The Pinnacle of the Card World The Card King messages Yuki , saying it was time to determine who the true Card King was. He says to go to the Electric Town South Exit, in which Yuki duels and defeats him. Shocked, the Card King reveals he was actually Leopardmon and passes his title of King on the Yuki. He says he plans to remain there for a while so he can continue playing, and will go to the rendezvous point before the final battle. Yuki receives a message from an unknown sender, who praises them for their win and says they've earned the right to duel them. Yuki goes to Shinjuku as instructed, and learns the mystery sender was the one who had given them their first cards eight years before. He says he is the true Card King, and challenges Yuki to determine who the real true Card King is. Yuki defeats him as well, and becomes the new true Card King. A Stubborn Fighter? Gankoomon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki , saying he's bored as he had been waiting for Jesmon — who hadn't shown up despite having agreed to meet at the Paradise Colosseum. Yuki visits him, and he asks Yuki to tell Jesmon he's waiting if they find him — saying Jesmon had gone off to try ramen. Yuki is able to find Jesmon and send him to Gankoomon Yaro-Kei Ramen , with Gankoomon thanking them — not just for finding Jesmon, but for telling them where the rendezvous point was. Gankoomon says Yuki deserves a reward...with the reward being a fight against Gankoomon. He also tells Jesmon to fight alongside Yuki, as he wants to see if Jesmon got rusty. They defeat him, and Jesmon suggests for the two of them to go to the rendezvous point. Gankoomon laughs, and says he actually could've gone there at any point and hadn't because Alphamon had told him to stop acting as a Royal Knight. This confuses Jesmon, and when he asks why Alphamon said that — even Gankoomon had no clue. He says Alphamon had been talking about how he thought the human race didn't deserve to live, and he didn't know whether he should listen to Alphamon or King Drasil . He says he'll make his choice later, and asks Yuki and Jesmon to be there when he does. Yaro-Kei Ramen Jesmon of the Royal Knights messages Yuki , saying he keeps getting the wrong Yaro-Kei Ramen order. Yuki visits him, and notices he looks awful. He says he's hungry and is close to dying, and explains again about how he keeps getting the wrong order. He says his master must be furious as he's late, and becomes shocked when Yuki says they know Gankoomon . Yuki explains how neither he nor Jesmon had gone to the rendezvous point, and he says he'll go there after he eats the correct ramen. He asks Yuki if they know how to order it, and they teach him how to do so. Jesmon is finally able to order and eat the ramen, and gives Yuki a reward as thanks. He then leaves to meet up with Gankoomon. Choosing a Human Representative! Gankoomon messages Yuki asking for help, as his friend is in a real fix. Yuki goes to Akihabara and meets up with both him and Jesmon , with the two of them being in front of an Outer Dunegon. Gankoomon says his human friend is inside, and that he wants to check on him. He says he'll make his choice of how to side with based on how it goes, either with Alphamon — who was assessing the humans, or King Drasil — who wants to protect the humans. He took Jesmon and Yuki with him as they can act as witnesses representing the Digimon and Human sides. Once inside, Jesmon and Yuki learn it's a bar — whilst Gankoomon finds his friend flirting with a LadyDevimon waitress. She tells him to pay for his bill, though he isn't able to afford it and asks Gankoomon for money. Gankoomon is surprised his friend has no money as he won him a lot in the arena, and his friend says he already spent all that money in this bar. He says he'd messed up as the money was for his family, and asks Gankoomon to fix a fight in the arena so they can make lots of money together. Gankoomon says he's made his choice, and Jesmon begs him to reconsinder saying not all humans are are bad as him and that Yuki is a good human. He correct Jesmon and says he's chosen to protect humanity, and that it'd be more fun to train weak humans like this one instead of destroying them. Wanting to help his friend, Gankoomon says he'll destroy the bar — causing LadyDevimon to ask Kuzuhamon for help. They beat it up and leave the bar, with the human seemingly not paying his bill. Gankoomon asks if he's learned his lesson, and he says yes — though he also asks to borrow money to get the train home. Gankoomon agrees, though says he'll show up at his house when his family is home if he doesn't pay it back. After the man leaves, Gankoomon says he doesn't actually expect to get the money back but has still decided to side with humans. Gankoomon notes how much Jesmon had grown during the fight with Kuzuhamon, and says it's time for them to go to the rendezvous point. Blink and You'll Miss It Asuna Shiroki messages Yuki , asking for help as she and Monica Simmons had encountered an unidentified flying object in Akihabara . Yuki meets up with them, with Monica saying it might be a Digimon and Asuna saying that capturing it will be hard as it's so fast — which is why she called in Yuki. Moncia says it seems to be following a defined path, and that she's narrowed down multiple points they could intercept it meaning they'll need to split up. She says the most likely spots were the ramen shop and the Sorayodo model shop, and has Asuna go to the model store whilst she and Yuki go to the ramen shop (as she had already gone to the model store that day and wanted Asuna to learn how amazing it was). They wait a long time, but it doesn't show up. Yuki gets bored and demands ramen, whilst Monica decides to call Asuna over to the ramen store. Asuna says she had bought a large amount of action figures, as she had ended up falling to the store's allure like Monica had wanted. Kentaurosmon crashes into them whilst they were distracted, and they realise he was the unidentified object. Kentaurosmon meanwhile is angry at them for getting in the way of his restaurant tour. They fight, with Kentaurosmon impressed at them being able to defeat a Royal Knight. He assumes they're friends of King Drasil 's due to their strength, with him mentioning his boss causing him to realise he was meant to be doing something else. He asks them where he was meant to go, and luckily for him — Yuki was indeed friends with King Drasil. Yuki tells him to go to the rendezvous point, and he remembers he already knew where that was. He gives them a reward and leaves, with Monica sad his tour was over and she wanted to suggest somewhere. Asuna then leaves, saying she needs to pick up her action figures. The Beautiful Knight Corps Dynasmon messages Yuki , saying that although he was at the rendezvous point — LordKnightmon wasn't, which he finds worrisome. Yuki goes to him, where he says LordKnightmon was meant to have arrived by now, and wonders if something had gone wrong in an investigation LordKnightmon was doing. He asks Yuki to go to Akihabara to find him, and Yuki finds him in front of an Outer Dungeon. LordKnightmon says his Knight Corps betrayed him and stopped following orders, and says he locked them inside the Dunegon. Kentaurosmon shows up and says he's not used to seeing LordKnightmon upset, and he agrees to help. Kentaurosmon says the Knights probably glitched because of the firewall in the human world, and that they're probably going to have to beat them up to bring them back to their senses. LordKnightmon had hope it wouldn't come to that, but ends up agreeing to fight them. The three of them go into the Dungeon, and kill them all. With that dealt with, LordKnightmon goes to the rendezvous point. A Display of Beautiful Swordplay Kentaurosmon messages Yuki , saying Dynasmon and LordKnightmon were arguing and it was annoying him. Yuki goes to them, and sees what they're arguing about. Dynasmon says LordKnightmon has no confidence in his swordsmanship, which is why he has his own army. LordKnightmon disagrees with this, and says he has the Knight Corps because it enhances his beauty. Dynasmon says Crusadermon had actually fallen behind his own minions in the way of the sword, that that was pathetic, and that he would've lost to his own minions had he and Yuki not been there. LordKnightmon says he will prove his strength by fighting Grademon, who is a renowned knight. LordKnightmon asks Yuki to go find Grademon, and Dynasmon tells them in secret that Grademon is at the Paradise Colosseum. Yuki tells LordKnightmon where Grademon is, and he leaves to go fight him. Dynasmon asks Yuki if he went too far, and Yuki says he did. He says he thought he hadand says he just wanted him to stop being so reckless. He sends Yuki after him, where Yuki finds Grademon having turned down a fight. Grademon says he has no reason to point his sword at him, and that he cannot fight a Royal Knight. Yuki says they have actually defeated Grademon before, and having heard this, LordKnightmon challenges them as defeating Yuki would mean he's also stronger than Grademon. Yuko defeats him, which upsets LordKnightmon — though he notes that Yuki is strong as they've defeated Grademon before. This being the case, it wasn't clear who was the stronger between them — leading him to ask Yuki who was stronger. Regardless of answer, LordKnightmon says he's satisfied and will return to the rendezvous point and make peace with Dynasmon. Alpha and Omega Agumon messages Yuki , saying to come to Central Tower so he can show all the Royal Knights that were there. Once Yuki arrives, Agumon celebrates at the fact that twelve of them (including himself and Gabumon as Omnimon ) had gathered. They say may be able to save the World now, but Alphamon suddenly appears and says that he is not quite sure of that just yet. They're surprised to see Alphamon showing up, since he's the empty seat, and Alphamon says he is going to test Yuki's virtue as there's nothing worse than a flawed sense of justice. He finds humans disgusting, as they justify their cruel experiments on Digimon as research — but is aware there are some humans that reject that notion. As such, he wants to see if those specific humans deserve his trust. Agumon and Gabumon try to talk him out of it by saying there's good humans, but Alphamon refuses to back down and says that's what he's here to determine. Agumon and Gabumon become Omnimon and join Yuki's side, and Alphamon is fine with this — saying to prove their faith in humans to him. They defeat him, and he acknowledges the strong bond between humans and Digimon as well as the potential of humans. He agrees to a ceasefire, and says he will observe things quietly from here on — but also warns he will take action if the humans stray. He praises Omnimon for his stregnth, and says he managed to prove humanity's potential. An Odd Letter Hiroko Sagisaka messages Yuki , asking for advice as she got an odd letter. Once Yuki arrives, Hiroko shows the letter is from Kosuke Misono , and that it may be a faker since it's weird he would send a letter to his own office. She says there was a key inside for a coin locker in Shinuku Station, but was too scared to open it on her own. Once they open it, they find a machine part — and Hiroko is certain she's seen something like this before. She thinks back, and thinks she remembers seeing it at the site of the big disaster and that Kosuke appears to have stolen and hidden it since then. They travel to the site, where an Outer Dungeon suddenly appears. It sucks them in, where they're confronted by Machinedramon — who had finally located its missing part. The Royal Knights show up, saying they had sensed an immense power — and offer to help. There was only enough space for one of them though, so Yuki chooses one to aid in the fight. They defeat Machinedramon, who dies saying it'll return and will reborn as many times as needed. After the battle, Hiroko says it makes sense that Kosuke had looked into it since that's where his wife and son died — and wonders if he sent the part so that they could get revenge for him. Despite their current strained relationship, Hiroko says she still believes in Kosuke and rewards Yuki for the help. Royal Knights' Test Match Agumon messages Yuki , saying the Royal Knights had recovered most of their strength and to meet up with them. Yuki goes to them, where Agumon says they all want to fight Yuki. Yuki then fights them all in thirteen separate battles. Olympos XII's Test Match A Minervamon from an alternate world messages Yuki , saying she wants to talk to them in Akihabara . Yuki finds her in front of an Outer Dungeon, where she says she and the rest of the alternate world Olympos XII want to fight Yuki. Yuki goes inside and fights all of them at the same time.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content_html:
Game Progress Route for Elden Ring covers a recommended progression path for the main campaign of the game. This progression guide maps out the optimal path to take to avoid missing objectives, important NPCs, Items, and many more without too much backtracking. This page only contains an overview of the game's main quest that will lead the player to reach the ending of the game. For a detailed guide on fully completing the game, visit the Walkthrough page.

  • For the Shadow of the Erdtree Route Guide, please visit the Shadow Lands Game Progress Route page.
  • Please note: The recommended level is not a determination of how hard an area is. It's following available materials and the natural progression of the walkthrough so far.
  • This playthrough doesn't follow every NPC and doesn't mention all Roundtable Hold interactions.

sections.title: West Limgrave
sections.content_html:
Level: 1~15 Upgrades: +0 ~ +1

  1. Buy Essential Gear
  2. Obtain Limgrave West Map Fragment
  3. Obtain Whetstone Knife
  4. Unlock Torrent & Spirit Bell
  5. Do Boc the Seamster's Quest
  6. Defeat Night's Cavalry.
  7. Find Sorceress Sellen (if you're a mage)
  8. Talk to Roderika
  9. Find Ashes of War Merchant
  10. Meet Potboy (Alexander)
  11. Talk to D, Hunter of the Dead
  12. Complete Murkwater Cave

Elden Ring Map: Limgrave Region starting point. Limgrave has a lot of places to visit, but only a few of them are essential. Right next to the First Step Site of Grace you'll find White Mask Varre. Exhaust his dialogue for some info about the world and to start his quest. Your first step will be to head to Church of Elleh and meet Merchant Kale, one of the Nomadic Merchants of the game. Patrolling between the starting point and the church is a Tree Sentinel boss. He will be extremely difficult at this stage of the game, so it is strongly suggested to avoid him until you unlock your horse and become stronger. Defeating him rewards you with his Golden Halberd. At the church, buy the Crafting Kit Kale offers, a Torch, and the Telescope. Also make note of the nearby upgrade bench. You can do optional cave and catacomb objectives to gain talismans and materials as needed.

Head over to Gatefront Ruins and obtain the Limgrave West map fragment for the area. Also pick up the Whetstone Knife so you can use Skills in your weapon and get Ash of War: Storm Stomp from an underground chest.

Visit 3 sites of grace, or rest in the Gatefront Site of Grace to speak with Melina and unlock Torrent, your mount. After this, teleport to the Church of Elleh Site of Grace to meet Renna and unlock the Spirit Calling Bell and get the Lone Wolf Ashes.

South-east from Gatefront Ruins (past east of the telescope on the map), you'll hear a shout belonging to Boc the Seamster. He's been transformed into a small red tree, so hit the small tree once and talk to him to begin his questline (see Side Quests for other quests). This quest will take you to the Coastal Cave (southern portion of the western beach), which also unlocks access to the Church of Dragon Communion (if you continue further in the cave without exiting it via portal). Defeat the demi-humans in the Coastal Cave, then go back to Boc at the entrance to return his Sewing Needle and Tailoring Tools. South-east from Boc's first location, a Night's Cavalry will spawn during night right on the bridge. Defeating him awards the Ash of War: Repeating Thrust.

If you are a mage or intend to learn sorceries, you will want to unlock Sorceress Sellen in Waypoint Ruins - follow the road south from Gatefront Ruins to find it. She's past the Mad Pumpkin Head Boss fight.

Head towards Stormhill (past the Gatefront grace leading west) and talk to Roderika to begin her quest and receive the Sitting Sideways gesture, alongside the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes. If you want to further Roderika's quest in its entirety, make sure to retrieve the Chrysalids' Memento in Stormveil Castle later. You will pick up a Golden Seed just before arriving at Stormhill Shack. There's also a Stonesword Key here that you will want to start collecting.

Follow the road East from the Stormhill Shack in Stormhill and you'll come to Warmaster's Shack, where you can purchase Ashes of War from Knight Bernahl. At night, Bernahl will be gone, and a Bell Bearing Hunterboss will spawn as you enter the shack. Note that this boss may be extremely challenging at this point in the game. Defeating him awards the Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing. Similar to ashes hunter badges in previous games, Bell Bearings unlock new items in the game's primary shop when given to the Twin Maiden Husks after you arrive at Roundtable Hold. Just south from here in the hills where the trolls are, you can visit at night and be invaded by a Deathbird mini-boss and get the Blue-Feathered Branchsword talisman.

Continue northeast along the road from Warmaster's Shack and turn right as you see a bridge and hear someone shouting. There is a small path to take up the cliff to your right-hand side. You will meet Alexander (Potboy) and can free him to begin his quest and earn the Triumphant Delight gesture and 1x Exalted Flesh. You have to hit him with a heavy attack or several times from behind.

Before we proceed, there's another dungeon nearby with useful loot, especially if you're going for an assassin type class. Return a bit west, to the barricades you passed through where you just fought the dog and commoners. Leave the barricades and head east along the road towards the bridge again. This time stick to the left of the road. Before the bridge, follow the path next to the cliff and you will find Deathtouched Catacombs. Inside there will be gathering/farm materials, upgrade materials, an Uchigatana, the talisman Assassin's Crimson Dagger and a Deathroot.

Further down the road, past the bridge, you can meet D, Hunter of the Dead, and begin his quest (if you already reached the Roundtable Hold before this point, he will not show up since you would have first met him at the hold instead of near past the bridge, but quest progression remains the same).

You will now want to return to the lower area of Limgrave, to go up the ravine from Agheel Lake until you find Murkwater Cave that has a special surprise, and then Murkwater Catacombs. You will get invaded here, so be careful! If you wait a bit to defeat the invader, Bloody Finger Hunter Yura will show up to help you defeat him. You can meet him back north of Murkwater Cave afterwards, where you can exhaust his dialogue to start his quest.

sections.title: East Limgrave
sections.content_html:
Level: 10~20 Upgrades: +1 ~ +2

  1. Talk to Kenneth Haight
  2. Get the Flask of Wondrous Physick
  3. Get Limgrave, East Map Fragment
  4. Get Flask Materials from Minor Erdtree
  5. Activate Siofra River Well
  6. Trigger Blaidd event.
  7. Liberate Fort Haight
  8. Get Reward from Kenneth Haight
  9. Complete Summonwater
  10. *Teleport to Bestial Sanctum

Elden Ring Map: East Limgrave Starting Point. East Limgrave doesn't have a lot of objectives, but the Rune Bears in the area are more than a challenge, so you should avoid them at all costs. Your plan for this area should be to loot and leave, as it's likely that you are underleveled for it.

First you will head to some broken structures along the northern cliff of the area (easiest place to start would be at the Artist's Shack grace or follow the road North from the Gatefront Ruins after passing the bridge). A group of demi-humans must be dispatched, then you can talk to Kenneth Haight atop the ruins, and agree to serve him. He asks you to liberate his keep to the south.

Continue following the road northeast from here until you reach the Third Church of Marika, where you can loot the Flask of Wondrous Physick and the Crimson Crystal Tear. This is an important flask for your journey so don't miss it!

Follow the road south until you find the area's map fragment. Beware of Rune Bears, but just by the map fragment you'll also find an altar with the Greenspill Crystal Tear and Spiked Cracked Tear. There's also a Teardrop Scarab nearby that drops Ash of War: Ground Slam.

Once you have looted the above, go inside the structure. Take the lift down all the way to the Siofra River, activate the Site of Grace down there, and head back up - you will come here later as it's very above your current level.

Nearby is the Mistwood Ruins, there is a howling wolf that you will hear. Once you hear him you can go back to the Church of Elleh location and talk to Merchant Kalé who will give you a gesture. Do the gesture (Finger Snap) to the wolf and he will jump down, and you can talk to Blaidd and start his quest.

Continue south from here, you can take a detour to meet the Nomadic Merchant of the area if you wish. To the very south, you will encounter Fort Haight. There's a Golden Seed to be picked up before you go in. Then kill all the enemies within and loot the tower on the right side from the entrance to obtain the very important key item: Dectus Medallion (Left). There's also Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (6) and Ash of War: Bloody Slash.

Now that the fort is free, report back to Kenneth in the northern area. He will reward you with Erdsteel Dagger and offer you the opportunity to enter into his service, choice is up to you. You'll next find him back at Fort Haight, where you fought the knight that dropped the Ash of War.

Once this is done, head to Summonwater (northwest from the Third Church of Marika), where you will face a Tibia Mariner boss. Defeat it to gain your second Deathroot and the Skeletal Militiamen Ashes, which will enable a discussion with D, Hunter of the Dead at the Roundtable Hold (you may also find him instead near the Summonwater Village Outskirts grace west of here if you didn't reach the Hold yet). In a chest in an underground area, you will find the Green Turtle Talisman.

Afterwards, go back to the Third Church of Marika. In the back there will be a portal that will take you to your next location. Open the door and rest at the site of grace. Melina will offer to take you to the Roundtable Hold (which again, if you have not already reached yet earlier from resting at enough graces, since activating them alone isn't enough).

  • If you have access to the Roundtable Hold, after that discussion a gateway will be marked on your map that allows you to teleport to the Bestial Sanctum in eastern Caelid. You don't need to do this now so don't worry about it if you haven't been to Roundtable Hold!

Liberate Fort Haight Get Reward from Kenneth Haight Complete Summonwater *Teleport to Bestial Sanctum Elden Ring Map: East Limgrave Starting Point . East Limgrave doesn't have a lot of objectives, but the Rune Bears in the area are more than a challenge, so you should avoid them at all costs. Your plan for this area should be to loot and leave, as it's likely that you are underleveled for it. First you will head to some broken structures along the northern cliff of the area (easiest place to start would be at the Artist's Shack grace or follow the road North from the Gatefront Ruins after passing the bridge). A group of demi-humans must be dispatched, then you can talk to Kenneth Haight atop the ruins, and agree to serve him. He asks you to liberate his keep to the south. Continue following the road northeast from here until you reach the Third Church of Marika , where you can loot the Flask of Wondrous Physick and the Crimson Crystal Tear . This is an important flask for your journey so don't miss it! Follow the road south until you find the area's map fragment. Beware of Rune Bears, but just by the map fragment you'll also find an altar with the Greenspill Crystal Tear and Spiked Cracked Tear . There's also a Teardrop Scarab nearby that drops Ash of War: Ground Slam . Once you have looted the above, go inside the structure. Take the lift down all the way to the Siofra River , activate the Site of Grace down there, and head back up - you will come here later as it's very above your current level. Nearby is the Mistwood Ruins, there is a howling wolf that you will hear. Once you hear him you can go back to the Church of Elleh location and talk to Merchant Kalé who will give you a gesture. Do the gesture ( Finger Snap ) to the wolf and he will jump down, and you can talk to Blaidd and start his quest. Continue south from here, you can take a detour to meet the Nomadic Merchant of the area if you wish. To the very south, you will encounter Fort Haight . There's a Golden Seed to be picked up before you go in. Then kill all the enemies within and loot the tower on the right side from the entrance to obtain the very important key item: Dectus Medallion (Left) . There's also Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (6) and Ash of War: Bloody Slash . Now that the fort is free, report back to Kenneth in the northern area. He will reward you with Erdsteel Dagger and offer you the opportunity to enter into his service, choice is up to you. You'll next find him back at Fort Haight , where you fought the knight that dropped the Ash of War. Once this is done, head to Summonwater (northwest from the Third Church of Marika), where you will face a Tibia Mariner boss. Defeat it to gain your second Deathroot and the Skeletal Militiamen Ashes , which will enable a discussion with D, Hunter of the Dead at the Roundtable Hold (you may also find him instead near the Summonwater Village Outskirts grace west of here if you didn't reach the Hold yet). In a chest in an underground area, you will find the Green Turtle Talisman . Afterwards, go back to the Third Church of Marika. In the back there will be a portal that will take you to your next location. Open the door and rest at the site of grace. Melina will offer to take you to the Roundtable Hold (which again, if you have not already reached yet earlier from resting at enough graces, since activating them alone isn't enough). If you have access to the Roundtable Hold, after that discussion a gateway will be marked on your map that allows you to teleport to the Bestial Sanctum in eastern Caelid . You don't need to do this now so don't worry about it if you haven't been to Roundtable Hold!

sections.title: Southern Limgrave & Weeping Peninsula
sections.content_html:
Level: 20~30 Upgrades: +2 ~ +3

  1. Meet Yura & Take on Dragon
  2. Obtain Sorcery Scroll
  3. Talk to Irina
  4. Defeat Night's Cavalry
  5. Obtain memory slot
  6. Get Sacred Tears
  7. Get Flask Materials from Erdtree
  8. Complete Castle Morne

Elden Ring Map: Southern Limgrave Starting Point. You are now ready to explore Southern Limgrave. Travel northeast to the underpass (directly west of the Artist's Shack, down at the ravine underneath a ruin) and talk to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura, then proceed to Lake Agheel to challenge and defeat the dragon in this area, Flying Dragon Agheel. You can summon players or use Spirit Ashes to help with the fight. Using Torrent is suggested. The Dragon Heart you obtain can be traded for Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion accessed by traversing through Coastal Cave.

If you are a sorcerer, you will want to obtain the Royal House Scroll, that you can bring to Sorceress Sellen to unlock more inventory at her shop. Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, toward the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Keep going to a structure to see a man standing watching over the big structure, alongside a dead body. In that body, you will find the Royal House Scroll.

To continue Blaidd's quest, head to the Forlorn Hound Evergaol and summon Blaidd for the fight against Bloodhound Knight Darriwil. Back outside he'll reward you with a Somber Smithing Stone (2) for helping him.

Proceed south into the Weeping Peninsula and you'll meet Irina by the road. She will ask you to talk to her father at Castle Morne. You will get there later so for now just continue down the road and rest at the Castle Morne Rampart site of grace. A miniboss roams the area at night. This is a Night's Cavalry and defeating him will give you the Ash of War: Barricade.

Take the jump spring near the Site of Grace to gain access to a tower. Oridys's Rise is a mage tower and contains an item that increases your memory slots, the Memory Stone. There are multiple of these to be found throughout the game, and they are usually in towers such as this one. You have to find and hit 3 turtles to unlock the entrance. See the Oridys's Rise page for details on where they are. After that, head north of the tower to find a site of grace, and a few enemies. Further after that, you'll find a corpse on a chair holding a Stonesword Key, and a statue which points to the nearby catacombs to complete.

Southwest from the Bridge of Sacrifice grace, there is a Forest Lookout Tower which rewards a Hand Ballista. Directly south of here is a grace named South of the Lookout Tower. If you play as a mage, your next stop is Demi-Human Forest Ruins (following the path west from this grace), as their leader drops the Demi-Human Queen's Staff which is quite good at low levels (you could also fast travel to the Sellia Crystal Tunnel grace you found earlier in Caelid, and find the Meteorite Staff in the Swamp of Aeonia on a corpse in the Street of Sages Ruins).

From here you will head North to find a Faith-knot Crystal Tear guarded by some hostile plants. Directly west is a church containing a Sacred Tear for your flask. South from here leads to both the Tombsward Catacombs and the Minor Erdtree, which contains both the Crimsonburst Crystal Tear and Opaline Bubbletear for your flask. Down the plains, you can see a Mausoleum: these are used to replicate Remembrances, which are the "Boss Souls" of the main bosses of the game.

Several points of interest are also west of the Minor Erdtree, including another church holding another Sacred Tear, and the Isolated Merchant's Shack, which you can buy a Lantern to avoid needing a torch for dark areas. Note that in the Witchbane Ruins north of the shack, the Sorceress Sellen is there, but there is no way to interact with her for now. Keep the location in mind, though, because it will become important in the later stages of her quest.

It's now time to take on Castle Morne south of where Night's Cavalry was. Note a golden seed right hand side on the path towards castle (which also leads to a map fragment of Weeping Peninsula). This is a simple souls-style dungeon, with a lot of verticality. Notable points are to not miss the drop to meet Irina's Father. From Take the lift to the castle proper and from the entrance go straight past a Pumpkin Head and to the right. Take the ladder, defeat nearby enemies and cross a bridge. With the bridge to your back look LEFT for some barrels. Break them to reveal a ladder and drop down below. Follow this path past some enemies and up a tower to meet Edgar.

Once you complete the boss of the area, return to Irina's father, and finally back to Irina to finish their quest. You can also go straight back to Irina without speaking to her father, in which case you skip out on some dialogue. (Note that I would advise against completing this quest too soon until your weapon upgrade is at least +8, because you'll obtain a+8 weapon after progressing enough in this questline, which may affect your ability to interact with other players since matchmaking is affected by weapon level).

sections.title: Roundtable Hold
sections.content_html:
1. Head up from Stormhill into Stormveil
  2. Defeat the Boss
  3. Visit Roundtable Hold
  4. Talk to all NPCs
  5. Upgrade your Weapons

Go into Stormveil and defeat Margit the Fell Omen at its gates to ensure you unlock a conversation with Melina that takes you to the Roundtable Hold. Once here, you should talk to all NPCs and familiarize yourself with the many locked doors.

There are several NPC quests you can start and continue here in the Roundtable Hold:

Roderika & Hewg: You'll find Roderika here once you've given her the Chrysalids' Memento (found in Stormveil) at Stormhill Shack, or have rested at any grace in Liurnia. She'll reward you with a Golden Seed if you have given her the memento - if not, you'll find a Golden Seed back a Stormhill Shack where she used to sit. Once Roderika is in the hold (this will be after Stormveil if you are following this route exactly), go back and forth speaking to Roderika and Smithing Master Hewg, choosing options that try to convince Hewg into taking Roderika as his apprentice. After you've exhausted all their dialogue, reload the Roundtable Hold and Roderika will now become your Spirit Tuner and the two will have additional dialogue. Return to the place you found the Chrysalids' Memento and you'll find the Crimson Hood in it's place. (Note: If you hadn't found the Chrysalids' Memento prior, it will be completely replaced by the Crimson Hood. The Memento is only used to progress Roderika's quest if you hadn't aquired the Liurnia of the Lakes Site of Grace early.)

D, Hunter of the Dead: After defeating the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village, D can be found and spoken to at the Roundtable Hold if you haven't already in Limgrave. He'll show you the way to find another NPC, Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. Once you visit Gurranq, D will sell his wares to you.

Gurranq can be found at the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid. If you teleport there as soon as you're given the waygate location by D, you may be a bit too underleveled to defeat the enemies there. Head straight into the building and don't fight the gargoyle here until you're strong enough to. His quest involves giving him Deathroot, and each time you give him one, you unlock a new item in his shop. After giving him the fourth Deathroot, an event triggers the next time you visit Gurranq. Damage your attacker until they've been pacified, but don't defeat them. Gurranq's quest ends after you've given him nine Deathroot.

Fia: You can start Fia's quest by speaking to her in her room in the Roundtable Hold. She'll only speak to you in secret if you let her hold you. Doing so will give you Baldachin's Blessing, which decreases your maximum HP while it's in your inventory.

Brother Corhyn: Corhyn's quest won't be started until a little later, but you can speak to him now for introductions and to purchase some incantations.

Diallos: You can start Diallos' quest by speaking to him here. Simply exhaust his dialogue then he'll show up in another location later on.

The most important thing to do here right now is to ensure that you Upgrade your weapons as much as possible as Stormveil Castle is a difficult endeavor and you will need all the help you can get.
